cards.name: Alakazam
cards.flavorText: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.flavorText: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. It frequently appears when sunspots flare up.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.flavorText: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.flavorText: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavorText: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.flavorText: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. This sprig is used much like a metal sword.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.flavorText: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

cards.name: Kadabra
cards.flavorText: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavorText: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: Often hides in water to stalk unweary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

cards.name: Abra
cards.flavorText: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.flavorText: Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.flavorText: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavorText: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything flat in moments.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Monster Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: A timid Fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: It accumulates negative ions from the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is three years old.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: If interrupted while miming, it will slap around the enemy with its broad hands.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.flavorText: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.flavorText: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of it.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin that is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.flavorText: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.flavorText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: A timid Fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.flavorText: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool; it is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a stinging sensation when it licks enemies.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.flavorText: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to K.O. targets.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.flavorText: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until its quarry is caught.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.flavorText: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: It spits out poisonpowder to immobilize the enemy, and then finishes the enemy with a spray of acid.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from elemental stones.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.flavorText: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname "Water Queen."

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speeds to stay airborne.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavorText: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.flavorText: A ferocious prehistoric Pokémon that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.flavorText: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: An extremely rarely seen marine Pokémon. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: Under a full moon, this Pokémon likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.flavorText: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that has been overhunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across water.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

cards.name: Muk
cards.flavorText: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.flavorText: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.flavorText: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: A mysterious Pokémon. Some say it is a lifeform from another dimension, while other believe it is formed from smog.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: Often seen swimming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

cards.name: Golem
cards.flavorText: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavorText: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

cards.name: Kingler
cards.flavorText: The large pincer has 10,000 horsepower of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Found at the mouths of volcanoes and extremely hard to spot. There are very few instances of capturing this Pokémon.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.flavorText: A prehistoric Pokémon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible for it to catch prey.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.flavorText: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: Capable of swimming backward by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: The Shellder that is latched onto Slowpoke's tail is said to feed on the host's left-over scraps.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two Koffings can fuse into a Weezing over many years.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds such as Pidgey and Spearow whole.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.flavorText: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.flavorText: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily Pokémon will use psychokinetic powers.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: If interrupted while miming, it will slap around the enemy with its broad hands.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.flavorText: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.flavorText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.flavorText: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.flavorText: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. This sprig is used much like a metal sword.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.flavorText: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

cards.name: Kadabra
cards.flavorText: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a stinging sensation when it licks enemies.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.flavorText: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to K.O. targets.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.flavorText: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavorText: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.flavorText: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: Often hides in water to stalk unweary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: It spits out poisonpowder to immobilize the enemy, and then finishes the enemy with a spray of acid.

cards.name: Abra
cards.flavorText: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.flavorText: Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.flavorText: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname "Water Queen."

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.flavorText: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavorText: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speeds to stay airborne.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavorText: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

cards.name: Dark Alakazam
cards.flavorText: Almost as if it were being controlled by something else, it never changes expressions, even in the middle of battle.

cards.name: Dark Arbok
cards.flavorText: Freezes its prey with its stare. If you should encounter one, remember not to look into its eyes.

cards.name: Dark Blastoise
cards.flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees.

cards.name: Dark Charizard
cards.flavorText: Seemingly possessed, it spews fire like a volcano, trying to burn all it sees.

cards.name: Dark Dragonite
cards.flavorText: Sometimes called "The God of Destruction." Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight.

cards.name: Dark Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: Digs large sinkholes in the ground and tries to trap its enemies in them.

cards.name: Dark Golbat
cards.flavorText: Sneaks up silently on its prey and attacks it from behind, sometimes killing it with one bite.

cards.name: Dark Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Normally found only in the deep ocean, it has recently been seen in shallow waters as well.

cards.name: Dark Hypno
cards.flavorText: Carries a pendulum with it always. Sometimes appears near less-traveled roads and schools at dusk.

cards.name: Dark Machamp
cards.flavorText: It is almost impossible to defend against a Machamp's four powerful arms.

cards.name: Dark Magneton
cards.flavorText: The number of incidents of hackers using Magnetons to damage computer systems is steadily increasing.

cards.name: Dark Slowbro
cards.flavorText: It loves nothing better than to be left alone, and so sometimes ends up being manipulated by unscrupulous people.

cards.name: Dark Vileplume
cards.flavorText: Perhaps because of their strong-smelling pollen, other Pokémon do not approach areas where Vileplumes live.

cards.name: Dark Weezing
cards.flavorText: Researchers have observed these Pokémon reproducing in industrial waste sites.

cards.name: Dark Weezing

cards.name: Dark Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: Its tail is incredibly strong, able to lift up to 5 adult men.

cards.name: Dark Dragonair
cards.flavorText: As is fitting for a legendary Pokémon, it has many strange powers, including the ability to make rain or snow fall.

cards.name: Dark Electrode
cards.flavorText: Some researchers hypothesize that Electrode may actually be a form of energy instead of having an actual body.

cards.name: Dark Flareon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a hot temper that can't be controlled once it's angered. Capable of breathing flames hotter than 3000°.

cards.name: Dark Gloom
cards.flavorText: Its pollen has such a strong smell that it even confuses itself at times.

cards.name: Dark Golduck
cards.flavorText: When Psyducks evolve, their headaches disappear and they find themselves in possession of formidable mental powers.

cards.name: Dark Jolteon
cards.flavorText: A dangerous Pokémon when angered. It likes to playfully shock people with the electricity it stores within its body.

cards.name: Dark Kadabra
cards.flavorText: Some people say that Kadabras are responsible for many of the mysterious events reported in the news.

cards.name: Dark Machoke
cards.flavorText: While normally peaceful and friendly, the number of incidents involving cruel Machokes is rising.

cards.name: Dark Muk
cards.flavorText: Muks appear suddenly, spreading sludge everywhere. Whenever one appears in a city, panic ensues.

cards.name: Dark Persian
cards.flavorText: Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet.

cards.name: Dark Primeape
cards.flavorText: Although Primeapes have always been mean, lately they seem to be becoming even more vicious and frenzied.

cards.name: Dark Rapidash
cards.flavorText: A wild, uncontrollable Pokémon. When running, it looks like a comet streaking through the sky.

cards.name: Dark Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools.

cards.name: Dark Wartortle
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a negative attitude, it hides in its shell whenever it's in a bad mood—which is often.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: Recent research has revealed the presence of dragon DNA in this species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: More and more people play the slots every day, trying to win a Porygon.

cards.name: Abra
cards.flavorText: It teleports itself away from danger, making it difficult to capture.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: Many people find it cute and try to hold it, only to be burned by its tail.

cards.name: Dark Raticate
cards.flavorText: A Raticate's front teeth are incredibly powerful; it can destroy a two-story house with them in 5 minutes.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.flavorText: It follows Onixes in their tunnels, looking for scraps of food they have left behind.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: The capture of the first Dratini inspired the search for other legendary Pokémon.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: Not popular with girls because of its attitude. Can often be heard muttering to itself in a low voice.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: A rare and unique Pokémon about which little is known, as few have been captured.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: A carnivore that swallows its prey whole. Pidgeys and Spearows are its favorite food.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: It has recently been found that Grimers are formed in waste-processing plants, and can move into towns via sewers.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: First discovered in a weapons factory, this Pokémon can now be found almost anywhere.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: It's said that not even pro wrestlers can take down a Machop.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It is said that enough Magnemites and Magnetons gather in one place, they can create a powerful magnetic barrier.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: Normally friendly, it quickly becomes angry if it doesn't get what it wants.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: A popular Pokémon that earns money for its owner with its "Pay Day" ability.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: It wanders around at night sowing its seeds to create more Oddishes.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: A gentle grass-eater, it will allow riders on its back. However, anyone attempting to do so must be careful not to get burned.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: It is often seen holding its head in its paws, as if it were suffering from a headache.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: Loves to eat walnuts, chestnuts, cheese, and milk.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Although it knows how to fish, no other intelligent behavior has been detected in it.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: Cute Pokémon that charms people with its innocent eyes. Loves swimming all day long.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: Usually seen only in power plants, it is sometimes seen in towns, apparently using the power lines to travel.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: Lives in dark caves. Can occasionally be seen at night, when it flies in search of food.

cards.name: Dark Raichu
cards.flavorText: Stores up electricity in its body, then suddenly releases it to surprise and shock everyone.

cards.name: Alakazam
cards.flavorText: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

cards.name: Dark Blastoise
cards.flavorText: An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees.

cards.name: Dark Dragonite
cards.flavorText: Sometimes called "The God of Destruction." Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight.

cards.name: Dark Persian
cards.flavorText: Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet.

cards.name: Dark Slowbro

cards.name: Dark Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: Under a full moon, this Pokémon like to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: It accumulates negative ions from the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

cards.name: Muk
cards.flavorText: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavorText: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Golem
cards.flavorText: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.flavorText: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.flavorText: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.flavorText: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

cards.name: Pidgeot

cards.name: Omastar
cards.flavorText: A prehistoric Pokémon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible for it to catch prey.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until its quarry is caught.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hope of racing it.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.flavorText: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: Capable of swimming backward by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: A mysterious Pokémon. Some say it is a lifeform from another dimension, while others believe it is formed from smog.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: It's said that not even pro wrestlers can take down a Machop.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: Normally friendly, it quickly becomes angry if it doesn't get what it wants.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.flavorText: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything flat in moments.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: It is often seen holding its head in its paws, as if it were suffering from a headache.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: Burrow deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: A wild Pokémon with a short temper. It is able to distinguish colors, and likes the color red.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: Years of genetic experiments resulted in the creation of this never-before-seen violent Pokémon.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, they attract so much electricity that they can cause lightning to strike.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can fly is spite of its large bulk. It is said to be able to circumnavigate the earth in just 16 hours.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon famous for its beauty. It looks almost as if it flies when it runs.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from elemental stones.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: Years of genetic experiments resulted in the creation of this never-before-seen violent Pokémon.

cards.name: Cool Porygon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

cards.name: Dark Persian
cards.flavorText: Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Meowth
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is more active at night. It likes bright, shiny things and cannot resist taking them and adding them to its collection.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily Pokémon will use psychokinetic powers.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: The flames on this legendary Pokémon's wings burn so brightly that they can make night seem like day.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to freeze the water in the air during winter, causing snow.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to be present wherever there is a lightning storm.

cards.name: Flying Pikachu
cards.flavorText: By learning how to fly, Pikachu overcame its weakness to Fighting Pokémon.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It uses its sensitive tail to sense its environment and has been known to react violently if its tail is grabbed.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Surfing Pikachu
cards.flavorText: One summer, a group of Pikachus was found riding the waves at the local beach.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: Still only a hatchling, it uses poison to chase off its enemies when threatened.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.flavorText: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.flavorText: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

cards.name: Igglybuff
cards.flavorText: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously—anytime, anywhere.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

cards.name: Unown [J]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.flavorText: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.flavorText: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

cards.name: Servine
cards.flavorText: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

cards.name: Servine
cards.flavorText: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.flavorText: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.flavorText: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.flavorText: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.flavorText: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.flavorText: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.flavorText: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.flavorText: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

cards.name: Sawsbuck
cards.flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.flavorText: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.flavorText: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue, then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.flavorText: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.flavorText: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

cards.name: Dewott
cards.flavorText: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

cards.name: Dewott
cards.flavorText: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

cards.name: Samurott
cards.flavorText: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

cards.name: Samurott
cards.flavorText: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.flavorText: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.flavorText: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

cards.name: Basculin
cards.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food—peat moss.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.flavorText: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.flavorText: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.flavorText: This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it's angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.flavorText: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Munna
cards.flavorText: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.flavorText: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

cards.name: Venipede
cards.flavorText: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

cards.name: Whirlipede
cards.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

cards.name: Scolipede
cards.flavorText: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponent and poison them.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.flavorText: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.flavorText: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thought, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.flavorText: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of timber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

cards.name: Gurdurr
cards.flavorText: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

cards.name: Throh
cards.flavorText: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.flavorText: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.flavorText: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.flavorText: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.flavorText: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.flavorText: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

cards.name: Klink
cards.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

cards.name: Klang
cards.flavorText: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.flavorText: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watches for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.flavorText: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.flavorText: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.flavorText: It loyally follows its Trainer's orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.flavorText: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.flavorText: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.flavorText: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

cards.name: Audino
cards.flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.flavorText: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.flavorText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: This is an extremely rare Pikachu card. You're very lucky to have found it!

cards.name: Surskit
cards.flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.flavorText: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

cards.name: Lileep
cards.flavorText: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

cards.name: Cradily
cards.flavorText: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: It flies by flapping its broad leaves and gives the sweet, delicious fruit around its neck to children.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.flavorText: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.flavorText: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

cards.name: Accelgor
cards.flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So it wraps a membrane around itself for protection while it spits poison.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.flavorText: Thought to be an embodiment of the sun, it appeared during a bitterly cold winter and saved Pokémon from freezing.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavorText: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.flavorText: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.flavorText: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

cards.name: Snover
cards.flavorText: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.flavorText: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

cards.name: Tirtouga
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. It swam skillfully and dove to depths beyond half a mile.

cards.name: Carracosta
cards.flavorText: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.flavorText: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon are called the "Signpost for Wandering Spirits." Children holding them sometimes vanish.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can't be a fixed destination.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.flavorText: When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.flavorText: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.flavorText: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.

cards.name: Munna
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.flavorText: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.flavorText: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.flavorText: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.flavorText: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.flavorText: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.

cards.name: Golett
cards.flavorText: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It's been active for thousands of years.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.flavorText: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.flavorText: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.

cards.name: Throh
cards.flavorText: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.flavorText: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

cards.name: Archen
cards.flavorText: It was revived from an ancient fossil. Not able to fly, it lived in treetops and hopped from one branch to another.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.flavorText: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: In order to build up its steel body, it eats iron ore. This pesky Pokémon is known to eat railroad tracks.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: Lairon fight over territory, and when their steel bodies collide, sparks fly.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.flavorText: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.flavorText: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: Its large tusks have a tendency to break, but each time they grow back, they grow in harder and sturdier.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.flavorText: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.flavorText: Its tusks are incredibly destructive. They can easily slice through a thick, sturdy steel column every time.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby play only when it feels safe.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavorText: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.flavorText: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.flavorText: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: Using its tentacles to lash itself to trees, it lies in wait for prey, luring it close with sweet-smelling drool.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.flavorText: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

cards.name: Servine
cards.flavorText: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.flavorText: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.flavorText: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.flavorText: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: It is said that Charizard's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Each of its nine tails is imbued with supernatural power, and it can live for a thousand years.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Pignite
