cards.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When it trouble, it emits smoke.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.flavorText: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

cards.name: Phione
cards.flavorText: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.flavorText: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

cards.name: Dewott
cards.flavorText: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

cards.name: Samurott
cards.flavorText: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.flavorText: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.flavorText: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Minun
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.flavorText: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.flavorText: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.flavorText: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.flavorText: It stares intently at everything. It can become so obsessed with watching that it doesn't notice attacks.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others

cards.name: Solosis
cards.flavorText: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.flavorText: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.flavorText: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

cards.name: Deino
cards.flavorText: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.flavorText: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.flavorText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.flavorText: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

cards.name: Servine
cards.flavorText: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.flavorText: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior's noble eyes.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: Extremely loyal to its Trainer, it will bark at those who approach the Trainer unexpectedly and run them out of town.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: When its opponent can't be paralyzed, it contorts itself with unexpected speed and flops away.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavorText: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

cards.name: Audino
cards.flavorText: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.flavorText: Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: It glides on its outstretched membrane while shocking foes with the electricity stored in the pouches on its cheeks.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.flavorText: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.flavorText: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.flavorText: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.flavorText: Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.flavorText: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

cards.name: Sawsbuck
cards.flavorText: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600º F.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500º F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.flavorText: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

cards.name: Basculin
cards.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

cards.name: Basculin
cards.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.flavorText: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.flavorText: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.flavorText: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.flavorText: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membranes and released while it is gliding.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.flavorText: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

cards.name: Venipede
cards.flavorText: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

cards.name: Whirlipede
cards.flavorText: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

cards.name: Scolipede
cards.flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.flavorText: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.flavorText: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.flavorText: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.

cards.name: Roggenrola
cards.flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

cards.name: Roggenrola
cards.flavorText: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

cards.name: Boldore
cards.flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

cards.name: Boldore
cards.flavorText: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

cards.name: Gigalith
cards.flavorText: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

cards.name: Throh
cards.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.flavorText: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.flavorText: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.flavorText: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.flavorText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

cards.name: Klink
cards.flavorText: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

cards.name: Klang
cards.flavorText: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.flavorText: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.flavorText: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.flavorText: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.flavorText: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves fell close to anyone other than their Trainers.

cards.name: Audino
cards.flavorText: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.flavorText: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.flavorText: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.flavorText: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.flavorText: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.flavorText: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.flavorText: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.flavorText: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.flavorText: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.flavorText: When they feel threatened, they spit acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.flavorText: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.flavorText: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.flavorText: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

cards.name: Accelgor
cards.flavorText: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.flavorText: It lives in water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.flavorText: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

cards.name: Tirtouga
cards.flavorText: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

cards.name: Carracosta
cards.flavorText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.flavorText: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.flavorText: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

cards.name: Frillish
cards.flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

cards.name: Jellicent
cards.flavorText: The fate of ships and crew that wander into Jellicent's habitats: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.flavorText: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.flavorText: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.flavorText: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.flavorText: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel it burns.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leaches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

cards.name: Gigalith
cards.flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

cards.name: Gurdurr
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

cards.name: Conkeldurr
cards.flavorText: It it thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

cards.name: Conkeldurr
cards.flavorText: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

cards.name: Archen
cards.flavorText: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.flavorText: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a volt of electricity.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attack. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

cards.name: Mienshao
cards.flavorText: It wield the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arms attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

cards.name: Golett
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.flavorText: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

cards.name: Deino
cards.flavorText: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.flavorText: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.flavorText: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

cards.name: Durant
cards.flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves against Heatmor.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

cards.name: Audino
cards.flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.flavorText: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: This is an extremely rare Meowth card. Maybe good fortune will come to you if you hold this card!

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.flavorText: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.flavorText: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.flavorText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature, it will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature, it will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.flavorText: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leaches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.flavorText: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

cards.name: Basculin
cards.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

cards.name: Frillish
cards.flavorText: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

cards.name: Jellicent
cards.flavorText: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. Their favorite food is life energy.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.flavorText: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays. It appears among filth.

cards.name: Muk
cards.flavorText: A toxic fluids seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

cards.name: Munna
cards.flavorText: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.flavorText: With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.flavorText: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.flavorText: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.flavorText: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.flavorText: They has mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.

cards.name: Mienshao
cards.flavorText: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.flavorText: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: It immediately headbutts anyones that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.flavorText: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.flavorText: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: It binds itself to trees on marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.flavorText: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.flavorText: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.flavorText: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.flavorText: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

cards.name: Accelgor
cards.flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.flavorText: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

cards.name: Blaziken
cards.flavorText: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch it foes.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.flavorText: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.flavorText: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.flavorText: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.flavorText: They warn other of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.flavorText: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas surrounding them.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food—peat moss.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Minun
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.flavorText: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.flavorText: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.flavorText: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.flavorText: Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

cards.name: Gurdurr
cards.flavorText: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavorText: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavorText: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.flavorText: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.flavorText: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

cards.name: Klink
cards.flavorText: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

cards.name: Klang
cards.flavorText: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.flavorText: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.flavorText: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.flavorText: It has a black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.flavorText: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.flavorText: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.flavorText: Blown by the seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavorText: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.flavorText: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.flavorText: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.flavorText: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.flavorText: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.flavorText: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

cards.name: Nincada
cards.flavorText: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

cards.name: Ninjask
cards.flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.flavorText: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.flavorText: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.flavorText: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.flavorText: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.flavorText: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.flavorText: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.flavorText: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.flavorText: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.flavorText: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through the water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.flavorText: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, the can make wave in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.flavorText: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.flavorText: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.

cards.name: Shedinja
cards.flavorText: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.flavorText: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.flavorText: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

cards.name: Golett
cards.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.flavorText: It flies around the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.flavorText: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.flavorText: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It move by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.flavorText: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

cards.name: Roggenrola
cards.flavorText: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

cards.name: Boldore
cards.flavorText: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

cards.name: Gigalith
cards.flavorText: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally are fired from its mouth.

cards.name: Throh
cards.flavorText: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.flavorText: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.flavorText: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

cards.name: Skuntank
cards.flavorText: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes it steely body against others to fight over territory.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.flavorText: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

cards.name: Durant
cards.flavorText: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels into mazes.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

cards.name: Deino
cards.flavorText: It tends to bit everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

cards.name: Deino
cards.flavorText: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.flavorText: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.flavorText: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.flavorText: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: It lives high among the treetops. It can us its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.flavorText: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.flavorText: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.flavorText: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes of dirt with its wings.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes of dirt with its wings.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.flavorText: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by the people nearby.

cards.name: Audino
cards.flavorText: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has radarlike ability to understand its surroundings through slight sounds.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: They great one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.flavorText: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a trail.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.flavorText: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.flavorText: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Tangrowth
