cards.flavorText: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: No matter how heavy its opponents, it flings them far away with its prized horn.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

cards.name: Servine
cards.flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.flavorText: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.flavorText: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.flavorText: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.flavorText: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: It is said that Charizard's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees F. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years–or whenever it becomes really angry.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.flavorText: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.flavorText: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 F.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.flavorText: It carries food all day long. When someone is lost in the mountains, it shares that food.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Dewott
cards.flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

cards.name: Samurott
cards.flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.flavorText: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

cards.name: Frillish
cards.flavorText: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

cards.name: Jellicent
cards.flavorText: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.flavorText: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.flavorText: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on contact.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: The instant it presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent, it sends over 20,000 volts of electricity into the foe.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.flavorText: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavorText: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.flavorText: Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.flavorText: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.flavorText: It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.

cards.name: Munna
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.flavorText: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.flavorText: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.flavorText: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

cards.name: Venipede
cards.flavorText: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state.

cards.name: Whirlipede
cards.flavorText: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But, when predators approach, it moves to stab them with poison spikes.

cards.name: Scolipede
cards.flavorText: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.flavorText: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It clamps on to its chosen prey then jabs the stinger on its tail into the prey while it's stunned with surprise.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.flavorText: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.flavorText: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.flavorText: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.flavorText: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.flavorText: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

cards.name: Mienshao
cards.flavorText: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.flavorText: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.flavorText: It makes a nest out of the bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.flavorText: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speed of over 180 mph.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

cards.name: Klink
cards.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Desert Spirit" this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

cards.name: Black Kyurem
cards.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: White Kyurem
cards.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: It searches for food all day. It gnaws on hard objects to wear down its fangs, which grow constantly during its lifetime.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.flavorText: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

cards.name: Taillow
cards.flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.flavorText: The reason it does not have a nest is that it simply searches for a clean, comfortable place then sleeps there.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.flavorText: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: By extending its rolled up ears and striking the ground, it can bound so high it surprises itself.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.flavorText: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.flavorText: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it's also smart enough to check its foe's strength and avoid battle.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.flavorText: This very loyal Pokémon helps trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.flavorText: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.flavorText: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.flavorText: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.

cards.name: Audino
cards.flavorText: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.flavorText: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.flavorText: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra's back and spend their entire life there.

cards.name: Combee
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a set of three. When they sleep, they gather up and form a giant hive of 100 Combee.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.flavorText: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.flavorText: Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.flavorText: When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.flavorText: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.flavorText: It moves the caps on both arms and does a dance to lure prey. It prefers damp places.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.flavorText: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.flavorText: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hand and feet. It will take on any opponent.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.flavorText: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when it absorbs life force from people or Pokémon.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavorText: Rooting the tip of its snout into the ground, it searches for food. Sometimes, it even digs up a hot spring.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.flavorText: With its excellent sense of smell, it's even able to find mushrooms that are buried under frozen ground.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.flavorText: When the temperature rose at the end of the ice age, most Mamoswine disappeared.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.flavorText: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.flavorText: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.flavorText: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.flavorText: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

cards.name: Frillish
cards.flavorText: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

cards.name: Jellicent
cards.flavorText: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.flavorText: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.flavorText: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways around the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: The stronger electromagnetic waves from the three linked Magnemite are enough to dry out surrounding moisture.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: The stronger electromagnetic waves from the three linked Magnemite are enough to dry out surrounding moisture.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.flavorText: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: It does not need eyes, because it emits ultrasonic waves to check its surrounding while it flies.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: It does not need eyes, because it emits ultrasonic waves to check its surrounding while it flies.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: Flitting around in the dead of night, it sinks its fangs into its prey and drains a nearly fatal amount of blood.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: Inhaling toxic fumes from trash and mixing them inside its body lets it spread an even fouler stench.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.flavorText: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.flavorText: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.flavorText: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.flavorText: Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven't been decoded.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.flavorText: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras made tangible by their emotions.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.flavorText: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

cards.name: Gurdurr
cards.flavorText: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

cards.name: Conkeldurr
cards.flavorText: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.flavorText: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

cards.name: Klink
cards.flavorText: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. They spin around each other to generate energy.

cards.name: Klang
cards.flavorText: A minigear and big gear comprises its body. If the minigear it launches at its foe doesn't return, it will die.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.flavorText: The minigear spins at high speed. Then the energy from the red core charges the minigear to make it ready to fire.

cards.name: Durant
cards.flavorText: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

cards.name: Durant
cards.flavorText: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: On nights with a full moon, Clefairy gather from all over and dance. Bathing in moonlight makes them float.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they're usually found in quiet places.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with telepathic power.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.flavorText: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.flavorText: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind-hearted people.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.flavorText: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another's rights and avoid needless strife.

cards.name: Whismur
cards.flavorText: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

cards.name: Loudred
cards.flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

cards.name: Exploud
cards.flavorText: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.flavorText: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.flavorText: Extremely cautious, there is always one keeping watch, but they don't notice enemies coming from behind.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.flavorText: They are known to charge so wildly that if a train were to enter their territory, they would send it flying.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.flavorText: It stands up to massive opponents, not out of courage, but out of recklessness. But that is how it gets stronger.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.flavorText: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavorText: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Sceptile
cards.flavorText: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.flavorText: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.flavorText: With cells similar to those of plants, it performs photosynthesis inside its body and creates pure air.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees F.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when it absorbs life force from people or Pokémon.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional-medicine ingredients.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can't be seen when it melts away into water.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavorText: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavorText: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.flavorText: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.flavorText: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.flavorText: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.flavorText: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.flavorText: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.flavorText: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148° F.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: By storing electricity in its body, it can shoot its bristlelike fur like a barrage of missiles.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: Lanturn's light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed "The Deep-Sea Star."

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.flavorText: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from its barbs can be fatal.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.flavorText: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than Nidorino's.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.flavorText: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

cards.name: Muk
cards.flavorText: It's so stinky! Muk's body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.flavorText: Its fur is so sensitive, it can feel minute shifts in the air and predict the weather…and its foes' thoughts.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: Its cells are all magnetic, and it communicates with others by using magnetic pulses.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.flavorText: With four linked brains, it's more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.flavorText: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.flavorText: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.flavorText: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: Opening its large mouth, it ingests massive amounts of soil and creates long tunnels.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.flavorText: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.flavorText: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavorText: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it's filled with a mysterious power.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: A smart and sneaky Pokémon, it makes its opponents flinch by suddenly showing the claws hidden in its paws.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: They communicate by clawing signs in boulders and work together to surround enemies.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: It appears from deep in the mountains to warn people about upcoming disasters it has sensed with its horn.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.flavorText: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.flavorText: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

cards.name: Deino
cards.flavorText: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

cards.name: Deino
cards.flavorText: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.flavorText: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.flavorText: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: The iron it ingested with the soil it swallowed transformed its body and made it harder than diamonds.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavorText: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: It searches for food all day. It gnaws on hard objects to wear down its fangs, which grow constantly during its lifetime.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.flavorText: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world's ways.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.flavorText: It is said that kids who drink Miltank's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.flavorText: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

cards.name: Starly
cards.flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.flavorText: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.flavorText: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.flavorText: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are know to relieve stress.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.flavorText: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.flavorText: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

cards.name: Samurott
cards.flavorText: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.flavorText: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Desert Spirit," this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.flavorText: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

cards.name: Black Kyurem
cards.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: White Kyurem
cards.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.flavorText: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.flavorText: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.flavorText: With four linked brains, it's more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.flavorText: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.flavorText: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.flavorText: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.flavorText: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavorText: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.flavorText: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Whether or not it's a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it's in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.flavorText: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.

cards.name: Lunala
cards.flavorText: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Solgaleo
cards.flavorText: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name "the beast that devours the sun."

cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.flavorText: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Dark Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Normally found only in the deep ocean, it has recently been seen in shallow waters as well.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Shining Magikarp
cards.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.flavorText: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven-colored wings.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.flavorText: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.flavorText: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.flavorText: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavorText: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.flavorText: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: Its fingertips emit a peculiar force field that hardens air to create an actual wall.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.flavorText: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.flavorText: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. It can even eat things off the ground.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Tyrogue
cards.flavorText: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.flavorText: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.flavorText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.flavorText: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

cards.name: Magby
cards.flavorText: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

cards.name: Mime Jr.
cards.flavorText: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.flavorText: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

cards.name: Quilava
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavorText: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sunrays.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like Pidgeotto to catch it mid-jump.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavorText: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.flavorText: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.flavorText: Discovered by chance during deep-sea explorations, it has not changed since ancient times.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven-colored wings.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.flavorText: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.flavorText: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

cards.name: Team Magma's Numel
cards.flavorText: No matter how heavy the cargo, we can transport it to our destination with ease, thanks to Numel.

cards.name: Team Magma's Camerupt
cards.flavorText: Camerupt, with its strength against fire, played a big role in rescuing team members.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Spheal
cards.flavorText: Spheal's Water Gun can put out any fire. Flames used by opponents have no effect!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Sealeo
cards.flavorText: It provides support by making paths of ice. It can win any battle as long as it's on ice.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Walrein
cards.flavorText: It's good at attacks that freeze opponents with a powerful cold snap. Then, it pulverizes a frozen foe with its sharp tusks!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Grimer
cards.flavorText: Its flexible body, which allows it to squeeze into any cracks, comes in handy when invading enemy hideouts.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Muk
cards.flavorText: It immobilizes its opponents by wrapping them in its huge, poisonous body. It'll smoosh you, too!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Seviper
cards.flavorText: Seviper's tail is a sharp blade. It can even poison you!

cards.name: Team Magma's Baltoy
cards.flavorText: They all cry out at once to let us know when they spot an enemy. It really helps out!

cards.name: Team Magma's Claydol
cards.flavorText: Claydol's beam can seize opponents and keep them from moving. Long-range attacks are its specialty!

cards.name: Team Magma's Aron
cards.flavorText: Aron, which even devour metal, can eat and destroy enemy ships in an instant.

cards.name: Team Magma's Lairon
cards.flavorText: When Lairon uses Take Down, the impact from its solid body is enough to destroy concrete!

cards.name: Team Magma's Aggron
cards.flavorText: Aggron's metal horns can smash through any defenses, no matter how strong!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Poochyena
cards.flavorText: Poochyena can easily detect invading foes with its acute sense of smell. It's an excellent lookout!

cards.name: Team Magma's Poochyena
cards.flavorText: Poochyena's nose can identify any scent. It's very useful for reconnaissance.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Mightyena
cards.flavorText: Thanks to Mightyena's outstanding leadership, it's very good at combination attacks that can leave a foe helpless.

cards.name: Team Magma's Mightyena
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is loyal to its master. It will protect its partner to the end, no matter what.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Carvanha
cards.flavorText: You can't keep up with its movements underwater, can you? If you get caught in this whirlpool, there'll be no escape.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: It boasts fangs so powerful that they knock opponents out in one shot! Enemies that slip up will be taken down without fail!

cards.name: Team Magma's Zangoose
cards.flavorText: Can you handle the formation attack of the fearless Zangoose?

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.flavorText: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Detective Pikachu
cards.flavorText: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created by years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: It grasps its opponents with its four arms and twists them up in an intricate hold. People call it "the Machamp special."

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

cards.name: Ditto
cards.flavorText: While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.flavorText: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.flavorText: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.flavorText: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

cards.name: Skuntank
cards.flavorText: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.flavorText: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.flavorText: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.
