cards.name: Bibarel
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.flavorText: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.flavorText: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.flavorText: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools that area by nearly 10 degrees F.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It's strong enough to hurl foes.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.flavorText: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.flavorText: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.flavorText: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.

cards.name: Munchlax
cards.flavorText: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.flavorText: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.flavorText: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavorText: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

cards.name: Wynaut
cards.flavorText: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.

cards.name: Budew
cards.flavorText: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.flavorText: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.flavorText: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.flavorText: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

cards.name: Elekid
cards.flavorText: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can't store the energy it makes.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.flavorText: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.flavorText: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.flavorText: MACHOKE's boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

cards.name: Mantyke
cards.flavorText: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.flavorText: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.flavorText: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.flavorText: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.flavorText: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.flavorText: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.flavorText: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

cards.name: Unown [A]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown [B]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown [C]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown [D]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Azurill
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

cards.name: Bonsly
cards.flavorText: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavorText: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.

cards.name: Combee
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.flavorText: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness if very popular among some.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.flavorText: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.flavorText: It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: It hefts a GRAVELER repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow on river bottoms.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Mime Jr.
cards.flavorText: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.flavorText: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

cards.name: Starly
cards.flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.flavorText: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.flavorText: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a STARLY, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

cards.name: Alakazam
cards.flavorText: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.flavorText: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.flavorText: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but is is said to appear only in peaceful times.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

cards.name: Lumineon
cards.flavorText: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.flavorText: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.flavorText: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.flavorText: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.flavorText: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

cards.name: Bastiodon
cards.flavorText: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.flavorText: To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.flavorText: To protect itself, it clads its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Once it appears, its rage never settles until it has razed the fields and mountains around it.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.flavorText: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.flavorText: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of Mantine swimming as if they are in flight.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

cards.name: Rampardos
cards.flavorText: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

cards.name: Unown [I]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavorText: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.flavorText: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting of tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.flavorText: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

cards.name: Chingling
cards.flavorText: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

cards.name: Cranidos
cards.flavorText: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.flavorText: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.flavorText: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.flavorText: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scale will heal even incurable illnesses.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.flavorText: Its tail also has a small brain. It bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on it from behind.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavorText: GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.

cards.name: Happiny
cards.flavorText: It loves round white things. It carries and egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.flavorText: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.flavorText: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO's.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: A mushroom grown larger than the host's body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

cards.name: Quilava
cards.flavorText: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burn more strongly when it readies to fight.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.flavorText: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.flavorText: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

cards.name: Shieldon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.

cards.name: Unown [E]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown [M]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown [T]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.flavorText: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still even for a moment.

cards.name: Abra
cards.flavorText: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.flavorText: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

cards.name: Finneon
cards.flavorText: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.flavorText: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

cards.name: Magby
cards.flavorText: Its body temperature is around 1,100 degrees F. It is healthy if it is breathing yellow flames.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the world's weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.flavorText: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.flavorText: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.flavorText: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a SNORUNT lives there.

cards.name: Snover
cards.flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.flavorText: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every sets of paws tastes unique.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer need to be careful.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: It is said that CHARIZARD's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.flavorText: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as "The Desert Spirit."

cards.name: Gallade
cards.flavorText: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.flavorText: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.

cards.name: Gastrodon East Sea
cards.flavorText: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

cards.name: Gastrodon West Sea
cards.flavorText: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.flavorText: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.flavorText: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.flavorText: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting to close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavorText: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.flavorText: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changes, and wings grew out.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavorText: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: It senses disasters coming and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

cards.name: Banette
cards.flavorText: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: Its three heads moves alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

cards.name: Furret
cards.flavorText: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.

cards.name: Golem
cards.flavorText: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can't harm it.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: It cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

cards.name: Minun
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Mothim
cards.flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.flavorText: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.flavorText: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as "The Bully of the Sea."

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.flavorText: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

cards.name: Unown [S]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

cards.name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
cards.flavorText: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
cards.flavorText: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Wormadam Trash Cloak
cards.flavorText: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.flavorText: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.flavorText: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.flavorText: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.flavorText: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer's feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.flavorText: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.flavorText: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

cards.name: Muk
cards.flavorText: A toxic fluids seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.flavorText: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.flavorText: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavorText: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.flavorText: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.flavorText: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.

cards.name: Smoochum
cards.flavorText: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

cards.name: Unown [K]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown [N]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown [O]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown [X]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown [Z]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.flavorText: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.flavorText: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

cards.name: Burmy Plant Cloak
cards.flavorText: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

cards.name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
cards.flavorText: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

cards.name: Burmy Trash Cloak
cards.flavorText: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: They can swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.flavorText: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can't live in polluted waters.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays. It appears among filth.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.flavorText: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.flavorText: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: If its usual headache worsens, its starts exhibiting odd powers. It can't remember doing so, however.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.flavorText: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: It uses the thorns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

cards.name: Sentret
cards.flavorText: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: It swims backwards by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

cards.name: Shellos East Sea
cards.flavorText: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

cards.name: Shellos West Sea
cards.flavorText: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.flavorText: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.flavorText: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.flavorText: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.flavorText: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.flavorText: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At nights, its kind is drawn by light.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavorText: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.

cards.name: Blaziken
cards.flavorText: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Sceptile
cards.flavorText: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

cards.name: Swampert
cards.flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.flavorText: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: It looks like a fluffy cloud when it is in flight. It hums with its soprano voice.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavorText: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.flavorText: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Exploud
cards.flavorText: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even if someone just woke up.

cards.name: Kingler
cards.flavorText: The larger pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.flavorText: When people bicker, it is said to arise from the depths of lakes to becalm violent hearts.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.flavorText: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

cards.name: Unown [H]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.flavorText: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.flavorText: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.flavorText: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.flavorText: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

cards.name: Gorebyss
cards.flavorText: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.flavorText: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.flavorText: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

cards.name: Huntail
cards.flavorText: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

cards.name: Linoone
cards.flavorText: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

cards.name: Loudred
cards.flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.flavorText: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.

cards.name: Marshtomp
cards.flavorText: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.flavorText: It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.flavorText: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.flavorText: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.flavorText: It is said to appear in front of kindly people to scatter a glowing down called "joy dust."

cards.name: Unown [F]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown [G]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.flavorText: It has feuded with SEVIPER for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.flavorText: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive 30 days without water.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.

cards.name: Clamperl
cards.flavorText: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.flavorText: It is famous for its shabby appearance. While populous, they tend to cluster in set locations.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.flavorText: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: It conveys its feelings using different cries. It works in a pack to cleverly take down prey.

cards.name: Igglybuff
cards.flavorText: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.

cards.name: Illumise
cards.flavorText: With its sweet aroma, it guides VOLBEAT to draw signs with light in the night sky.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.flavorText: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.flavorText: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.flavorText: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: The world's first artificially created Pokémon. It can travel through electronic space.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: Its wings are like cotton tufts. If it perches on someone's head, it looks like a cotton hat.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that it shares with kindhearted people.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

cards.name: Unown [L]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Volbeat
cards.flavorText: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE's sweet aroma.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

cards.name: Whismur
cards.flavorText: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs.  If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.

cards.name: Zigzagoon
cards.flavorText: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.flavorText: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.flavorText: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Phione
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.flavorText: Its fur has the look and feel of velvet. The orb on its forehead glows when it uses psycho-power.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: It has a flame sac in its body. Its body temperature tops 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit before battle.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.flavorText: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.flavorText: Its huge mouth is almost seven feet across. It has enough power to completely crush a car.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.flavorText: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: It controls 10,000-volt power and can raise all the furs on its body as if it were sharp needles.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.flavorText: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

cards.name: Minun
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

cards.name: Phione
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.flavorText: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.flavorText: Groups of this Pokémon migrating in search of water have been mistaken for "moving forests."

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: The toxin made in its poison sacs is pumped to the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavorText: The light of the moon changed Eevee's genetic structure. It lurks in darkness for prey.

cards.name: Unown [P]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: It has evolved to be suitable for aquatic life. It can invisibly melt away into water.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.flavorText: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.flavorText: The shell is hardened soil. Some Pokémon come to peck the berries growing on the trees on its back.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.flavorText: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

cards.name: Mothim
cards.flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It lives atop trees.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.flavorText: Its wings deliver wicked blows that snap even the thickest of trees. It searches for prey in icy seas.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja's.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.flavorText: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: It stands along paths pretending to be a tree. If it starts raining, it seems to disappear.

cards.name: Unown [Q]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: It lives atop giant trees. It wraps its tail around a branch so it won't fall off while asleep.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: X-ray photos were taken to check its body structure. Nothing appeared, however.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

cards.name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
cards.flavorText: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

cards.name: Chingling
cards.flavorText: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

cards.name: Combee
cards.flavorText: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: It tugs on the hands of children to steal them away. However, it gets pulled around instead.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.flavorText: With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.flavorText: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.flavorText: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

cards.name: Munchlax
cards.flavorText: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.

cards.name: Shellos East Sea
cards.flavorText: It lives along bodies of water. Its body shape changed to suit its habitat.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.

cards.name: Starly
cards.flavorText: Usually with a large flock, it is barely noticeable when alone. Its cries are very strident.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.flavorText: It sprays a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Deoxys Normal Forme
cards.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.flavorText: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

cards.name: Heatran
cards.flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavorText: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.flavorText: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.flavorText: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Politoed
cards.flavorText: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.flavorText: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units call Mini-Noses.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.flavorText: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

cards.name: Armaldo
cards.flavorText: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.flavorText: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

cards.name: Cradily
cards.flavorText: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

cards.name: Crawdaunt
cards.flavorText: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

cards.name: Deoxys Attack Forme
cards.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys Defense Forme
cards.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys Speed Forme
cards.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.flavorText: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.flavorText: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.flavorText: With extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

cards.name: Regice
cards.flavorText: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

cards.name: Registeel
cards.flavorText: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

cards.name: Shedinja
cards.flavorText: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

cards.name: Unown [!]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.flavorText: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

cards.name: Anorith
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.flavorText: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

cards.name: Castform
cards.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

cards.name: Castform Rain Form
cards.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

cards.name: Castform Snow-Cloud Form
cards.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

cards.name: Castform Sunny Form
cards.flavorText: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: Lanturn's light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed "The Deep-Sea Star."

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: Lanturn's light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed "The Deep-Sea Star."

cards.name: Ledian
cards.flavorText: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.flavorText: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.

cards.name: Ninjask
cards.flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.flavorText: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

cards.name: Swalot
cards.flavorText: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

cards.name: Swellow
cards.flavorText: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dive steeply to catch the prey.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.

cards.name: Unown [J]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Unown [R]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Unown [U]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Unown [V]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Unown [W]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Unown [Y]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like an ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Unown [?]
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.flavorText: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It sails on the winds with its limbs extended to strike from the sky. It aims for the prey's face.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It sails on the winds with its limbs extended to strike from the sky. It aims for the prey's face.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

cards.name: Gulpin
cards.flavorText: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.flavorText: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: It conveys its feelings using different cries. It works in a pack to cleverly take down prey.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.flavorText: It is so timid, it can't move if it isn't with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.

cards.name: Lileep
cards.flavorText: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.

cards.name: Nincada
cards.flavorText: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.flavorText: Its nose is a magnet. As a result, this Pokémon always keeps its face pointing north.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavorText: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavorText: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.flavorText: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.flavorText: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavorText: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.

cards.name: Taillow
cards.flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.

cards.name: Tyrogue
cards.flavorText: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.

cards.name: Yanma
