cards.flavorText: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.flavorText: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.flavorText: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.flavorText: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.flavorText: Machoke's boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: It is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: It is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.flavorText: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.flavorText: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: Its body is hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja's.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.flavorText: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Finneon
cards.flavorText: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the world's weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.flavorText: Roselia raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

cards.name: Snover
cards.flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

cards.name: Starly
cards.flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.flavorText: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavorText: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

cards.name: Cranidos
cards.flavorText: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

cards.name: Shieldon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.

cards.name: Mime Jr.
cards.flavorText: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.flavorText: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness if very popular among some.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

cards.flavorText: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Arceus
cards.flavorText: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.flavorText: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.flavorText: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

cards.name: Dragonair

cards.name: Dragonair

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: Its body is covered in a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.flavorText: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.flavorText: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.

cards.name: Pikachu on the Ball
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Eevee on the Ball
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Grookey on the Ball
cards.flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

cards.name: Scorbunny on the Ball
cards.flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

cards.name: Sobble on the Ball
cards.flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: It swings its long antlers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.flavorText: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.flavorText: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from it mouth.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal the victim's life force. It lurks in darkness for prey.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.flavorText: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavorText: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

cards.name: Golem
cards.flavorText: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.flavorText: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavorText: Running around, climbing trees, playing hide-and-seek! Another wonderful day begins!

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.flavorText: I wonder if I would look a little cuter with a beautiful flower?

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: My Charmander is so rambunctious! I wonder if we can become good friends?

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: My precious friend who is always with me. I have so many things I want to tell you.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: No matter what happens, if we stick together, we can get past it. Forever and ever.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: What a delicious-looking snowman! I think I'll sneak a bite. It's OK…no one's looking, right?

cards.name: Froslass
cards.flavorText: Spring is already here, so goodbye…

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: The plan for today is to do nothing. My awesome tail is all curled up, and my ears are tired, too.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: Crackle…buzz…Dedenne…?! Beep…

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavorText: When she's surrounded by cushions and dressers that I like, she looks just like a princess!

cards.name: Gulpin
cards.flavorText: When Mom gets in the kitchen, the happiest things happen. I can feel my mouth watering!

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: The twinkle of the stars. The destiny of love. A miracle that grants wishes in the night sky.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.flavorText: My number one. Exceptionally cute. A little princess.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.flavorText: Intense silence. Two lamplights. Keep waiting for night to end.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: Hidden away in its jet-black wings is a red passion.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.flavorText: It's OK. No one will take away your flower. You look cute even when you're angry.

cards.name: Floette
cards.flavorText: The five of us team up to be the Pretty Young Girl Force! We'll show you some beautiful moves!

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.flavorText: My fluffy heart makes me feel like a marshmallow. A thrilling macaron full of colorful magic. Everybody's crazy about the taste of candy! ☆

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.flavorText: The cakes Slurpuff makes always look just like that one Pokémon it likes.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.flavorText: Open the magic door and a dream-colored party will start again today. I'll teach you the secret password.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: Wings and beaks. I like yours, and I like mine, too.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: This fluffiness makes everyone go crazy. Is it really that charming?

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.flavorText: Little friends, thanks for always helping me look so cute!

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A yellow body is proof of good health. If you touch its bright-red cheeks, you'll see its shining, smiling face!

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.flavorText: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.flavorText: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores—it can even float around the world.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavorText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.flavorText: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.flavorText: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.flavorText: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heaviest of rains.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: If a head drops off, it emits a telepathic call in search of others to form an Exeggcute cluster.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

cards.name: Furret
cards.flavorText: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.flavorText: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.flavorText: The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.flavorText: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.flavorText: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spike and claws. They grow back in a day.

cards.name: Smoochum
cards.flavorText: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.flavorText: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Tyrogue
cards.flavorText: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.flavorText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.flavorText: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.flavorText: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.flavorText: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.flavorText: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

cards.name: Igglybuff
cards.flavorText: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously—anytime, anywhere.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.flavorText: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: It prepares for evolution by hardening its shell as much as possible to protect its soft body.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.flavorText: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

cards.name: Quilava
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.flavorText: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

cards.name: Unown
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown
cards.flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a Body Slam.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavorText: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Using telepathy only they can employ, they always form a cluster of six Exeggcute.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.flavorText: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.flavorText: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.flavorText: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like Pidgeotto to catch it mid-jump.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: As its body grows large, large mushrooms named tochukaso start sprouting out of its back.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavorText: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

cards.name: Sentret
cards.flavorText: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.flavorText: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.flavorText: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavorText: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

cards.name: Ho-Oh LEGEND
cards.flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

cards.name: Ho-Oh LEGEND
cards.flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

cards.name: Lugia LEGEND
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Lugia LEGEND
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: They say that during past strife, Gyarados would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Politoed
cards.flavorText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.flavorText: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavorText: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.flavorText: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavorText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras, even foes it could not otherwise see.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.flavorText: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.flavorText: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It has an insolent nature that makes it not care about others.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.flavorText: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.flavorText: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

cards.name: Minun
cards.flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavorText: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: It is born deep underground. It can't emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavorText: The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.flavorText: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.flavorText: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: Capable of flying safely in dark places, it emits ultrasonic cries to check for any obstacles.

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.flavorText: Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.flavorText: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.flavorText: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.flavorText: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavorText: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.flavorText: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.flavorText: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.flavorText: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.flavorText: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.flavorText: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.flavorText: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control Combee.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

cards.name: Muk
cards.flavorText: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: With its horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: Its whiskers help it to maintain balance. Its fangs never stop growing, so it gnaws to pare them down.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its protective colors make it invisible.

cards.name: Skuntank
cards.flavorText: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: Naturally dull to begin with, it lost its ability to feel pain due to Shellder's seeping poison.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

cards.name: Unown
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

cards.name: Combee
cards.flavorText: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its environment changes.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: Wherever Grimer has passed, so many germs are left behind that no plants will ever grow again.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.flavorText: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day it stays quietly underground.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It hangs and waits for flying insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: A sweet sap leaks from its tail's tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: Vicious in nature, it drives Pidgey from their nests and scavenges any leftovers it can find.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.flavorText: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.flavorText: You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.flavorText: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.flavorText: Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can render the victim helpless quite easily.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error…

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.flavorText: The powder on its wings is poisonous if it is dark in hue. If it is light in hue, it causes paralysis.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.flavorText: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.flavorText: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

cards.name: Banette
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.flavorText: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: This marine Pokémon has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

cards.name: Elekid
cards.flavorText: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.flavorText: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.flavorText: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.flavorText: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.flavorText: It has space in its throat to store saliva. It can also roll up its tongue and store it in the same spot.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.flavorText: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.flavorText: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.

cards.name: Magby
cards.flavorText: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: The fiery surface of its body gives off a wavering, rippling glare that is similar to the sun.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: The Magnemite are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.flavorText: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.flavorText: It has a calm and caring nature. Because its horn grows slowly, it prefers not to fight.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.flavorText: Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with its horn to inject a powerful poison when it becomes agitated.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.flavorText: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.flavorText: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

cards.name: Unown
cards.flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.flavorText: The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.flavorText: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

cards.name: Illumise
cards.flavorText: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.flavorText: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.flavorText: Although not very combative, it will torment its foes with poison spikes if it is threatened in any way.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.flavorText: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. It will strike first if it senses any danger.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.flavorText: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: A manmade Pokémon that came about as a result of research. It is programmed with only basic motions.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.flavorText: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it's said. It's very active at night.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.flavorText: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.flavorText: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: It drifts aimlessly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavorText: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches and eats small bugs at night that are attracted by light.

cards.name: Volbeat
cards.flavorText: It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavorText: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind when it flies.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavorText: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.flavorText: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Smoochum
cards.flavorText: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Minun
cards.flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.flavorText: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to contain its sheer power, it races headlong around the land.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn't breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment..

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.flavorText: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

cards.name: Munna
cards.flavorText: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Klink
cards.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

cards.name: Audino
cards.flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

cards.name: Servine
cards.flavorText: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.flavorText: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

cards.name: Dewott
cards.flavorText: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membranes and released while it is gliding.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Klang
cards.flavorText: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.flavorText: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.flavorText: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

cards.name: Furfrou
cards.flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.flavorText: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

cards.name: Zigzagoon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett
cards.flavorText: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

cards.name: Pikipek
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.flavorText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn't really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn't particularly bothered.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.
