cards.name: Politoed
cards.flavorText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.flavorText: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.flavorText: It swings its eye patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.flavorText: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavorText: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

cards.name: Unown [A]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavorText: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen berries.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.flavorText: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its environment changes.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

cards.name: Igglybuff
cards.flavorText: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it prepares to evolve. It stays motionless in the shell.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.flavorText: Apparently, it cracked Shellder's shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavorText: The swirl on its belly undulates. Staring at it may gradually cause drowsiness.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

cards.name: Unown [D]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown [F]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown [M]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown [N]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown [U]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.flavorText: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.flavorText: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.flavorText: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavorText: Because it is inept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.

cards.name: Sentret
cards.flavorText: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.flavorText: It spins a web using fine – but durable – thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

cards.name: Tyrogue
cards.flavorText: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

cards.name: Unown [E]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown [I]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown [O]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavorText: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavorText: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.flavorText: Anyone who takes even one bite of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.flavorText: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

cards.name: Ho-oh
cards.flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven colored wings.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.flavorText: Drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: Three Magnemites are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.flavorText: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavorText: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.flavorText: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavorText: When Celebi disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

cards.name: Ho-oh
cards.flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavorText: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavorText: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rockhard head.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushrooms on its back.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.flavorText: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.flavorText: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.flavorText: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

cards.name: Unown [B]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown [Y]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant sticks grow, it uses its own stick to thwart them.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: It uses its arms to steadily climb steep mountain paths. It swings its fists around if angered.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.flavorText: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in the water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavorText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

cards.name: Smoochum
cards.flavorText: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many people like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavorText: If it smells something enticing, it dashes headlong off to find the source of the aroma.

cards.name: Unown [K]
cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.

cards.name: Shining Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Shining Magikarp
cards.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Dark Ampharos
cards.flavorText: Its brightly lit tail can be seen for miles in the dark, even by ships on the sea.

cards.name: Dark Crobat
cards.flavorText: Although the wings it has evolved on its feet allow it to fly at high speeds, they unfortunately make it difficult to perch.

cards.name: Dark Donphan
cards.flavorText: The larger its tusks, the higher its status in the herd.

cards.name: Dark Espeon
cards.flavorText: The tips of its split tail quiver whenever it uses its psychic abilities to read its opponent's next move.

cards.name: Dark Feraligatr
cards.flavorText: Its powerful muscles allow it to move at a speed that belies its bulk.

cards.name: Dark Gengar
cards.flavorText: It absorbs the heat in the air around it. If you suddenly feel cold, it's because a Gengar has appeared.

cards.name: Dark Houndoom
cards.flavorText: The flame it breathes is actually a volatile poison it produces internally that ignites when exposed to air.

cards.name: Dark Porygon2
cards.flavorText: Advances in technology have allowed it to evolve. It occasionally displays behavior not found in its programming.

cards.name: Dark Scizor
cards.flavorText: Nothing can withstand the pressure of the vise-like grip of this Pokémon's steel claws.

cards.name: Dark Typhlosion
cards.flavorText: When it's in combat, the air around it shimmers and warps from the intense heat it produces.

cards.name: Dark Tyranitar
cards.flavorText: Its power is such that not even mountains can stand in its way.

cards.name: Light Arcanine
cards.flavorText: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is easily recognized by its large flowing mane.

cards.name: Light Azumarill
cards.flavorText: It curls up its long ears when swimming to prevent water from entering them.

cards.name: Light Dragonite
cards.flavorText: It is said to fly constantly over the sea, looking for people in need of aid.

cards.name: Light Togetic
cards.flavorText: It becomes depressed if it is not near kind-hearted people. Is is able to float in the air without moving its wings.

cards.name: Dark Ariados
cards.flavorText: Wherever it goes, it spins a thread that always leads back to its web.

cards.name: Dark Magcargo
cards.flavorText: The shell on its back comes off easily, exposing the flames running through its body.

cards.name: Dark Omastar
cards.flavorText: Nothing can escape once wrapped in its tentacles, which it uses for self-defense as well as to catch food.

cards.name: Dark Slowking
cards.flavorText: Each time it yawns, the Shellder on its head releases an enzyme that makes it grow even smarter.

cards.name: Dark Ursaring
cards.flavorText: Its keen nose can pick out any scent, even that of food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Light Dragonair
cards.flavorText: The aura it projects from its body has an effect on the surrounding climate and weather.

cards.name: Light Lanturn
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has evolved its dorsal fin to emit light, which attracts the fish it feeds on.

cards.name: Light Ledian
cards.flavorText: The number of spots on its back increase or decrease depending on the number of stars visible in the night sky.

cards.name: Light Machamp
cards.flavorText: It uses its four arms in combat to unleash a ceaseless flurry of punches.

cards.name: Light Piloswine
cards.flavorText: Its legs are short, but its hooves are wide and flat, allowing it to easily walk over snow.

cards.name: Unown [G]
cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [H]
cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [W]
cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [X]
cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: It holds its egg carefully when moving so as not to break it. Still, it is fast enough to disappear in the blink of an eye.

cards.name: Dark Croconaw
cards.flavorText: It has 49 teeth in its mouth that are constantly replacing themselves. Pull one out, and a new one grows in.

cards.name: Dark Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: If one of its heads falls off, it turns into an Exeggcute, which begins to look for other Exeggcutes using a special form of telepathy.

cards.name: Dark Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: As a result of storing massive amounts of electricity there, it can no longer grow wool on certain areas of its body.

cards.name: Dark Forretress
cards.flavorText: It stays motionless in trees, driving away with flying armored shards from its hard shell any who come close.

cards.name: Dark Haunter
cards.flavorText: It silently hunts its prey in dark rooms.

cards.name: Dark Omanyte
cards.flavorText: This ancient Pokémon possessed 10 tentacles, which it used to swim through the ocean.

cards.name: Dark Pupitar
cards.flavorText: It is encased within a hard shell, yet retains a great deal of mobility—a dangerous combination.

cards.name: Dark Quilava
cards.flavorText: If it turns its back to an opponent, it is a sign that it is getting ready to attack.

cards.name: Dark Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has soft, fine hair. When angered, it increases in size and has been known to charge those it considers a threat.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: It is normally peaceful, but will attack any who get between it and honey, its favorite food.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: It has a perfect sense of balance and can lash out with powerful kicks from any position.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: When night falls, the air fills with the eerie cries of this Pokémon as it stakes out its territory.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: If puffs its body up like a balloon and sings a lullaby that makes all who hear it fall into a deep sleep.

cards.name: Light Dewgong
cards.flavorText: It has an aerodynamic shape that allows it to swim at great speeds. The colder the water gets, the more active it becomes.

cards.name: Light Flareon
cards.flavorText: It creates its flames by swallowing air into a special pouch within its body, then heating it to over 3000 degrees.

cards.name: Light Golduck
cards.flavorText: The faster it swims, the brighter the glow on its forehead becomes.

cards.name: Light Jolteon
cards.flavorText: It can collect the ambient electrical energy in its cells and expel it in massive bursts.

cards.name: Light Machoke
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon never gets tired, no matter what it does or how hard it works.

cards.name: Light Ninetales
cards.flavorText: It is said that each of its nine tails contains a different magical power.

cards.name: Light Slowbro
cards.flavorText: If the Shellder attached to its tail becomes separated, this Pokémon reverts to a normal Slowpoke.

cards.name: Light Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: If its fins being to vibrate, it is a sign that it will begin raining soon.

cards.name: Light Venomoth
cards.flavorText: It defends itself by flapping its wings at high speed, spreading poisonous powder throughout the air.

cards.name: Light Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: If two of them brush against each other, they will not be able to separate themselves, as they enjoy touching each other's soft fur too much.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: It moves so fast as to be invisible to the naked eye. Even when standing still, its camouflage prevents it from being seen.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: Its shell is said to contain happiness itself, which it will share with those who are kind to it.

cards.name: Unown [C]
cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [P]
cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [Q]
cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [Z]
cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It is very meek and constantly crouches in a defensive posture. When threatened, it protects itself with the flame on its back.

cards.name: Dark Octillery
cards.flavorText: It likes to sleep in rock caves and will even steal other Octillery's nests.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: Large from birth, this Pokémon increases in size throughout its life by regularly shedding its skin.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Its shell is very durable, allowing it to survive even if the shell becomes cracked.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: Its gas-like body allows it to enter almost anywhere, but it is vulnerable to high winds.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.flavorText: Its tail has a brain of its own, which can respond to stimuli such as scents. Many unsuspecting people have been bitten by it.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It spends its days hanging from cliffs, swooping down on any prey it spots from its high vantage point.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It fears nothing, not even opponents larger than itself.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: Its punches are blindingly fast, but it can only fight for three minutes before tiring and needing to rest.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: It is born deep within the ground and has to burrow its way out.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.flavorText: Sensitive to cold, Ledyba gather in groups to share warmth when the temperature drops.

cards.name: Light Sunflora
cards.flavorText: Although it is extremely active during the day, it stops moving entirely as soon as the sun sets.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: When bored, this super-strong Pokémon trains by lifting rocks.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is perfectly adapted to its ocean home. It can gather up enough speed to burst above the water like a whale.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Its soft wool coat captures air, allowing it to remain cool during the summer and warm in the winter.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavorText: It hits people with its nose as a sign of affection but doesn't know its own strength and so sometimes knocks people off their feet.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It waits suspended from tree branches for insects to fly into its mouth, often not moving for hours at a time.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created by human computer engineering. Its program is only capable of simple action and reaction.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Although possessed of great mental powers, it doesn't know how to use them.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: It can shoot a burst of water from its mouth to propel itself backward at high speeds, allowing it to flee from surprised enemies.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: Although clumsy on land, it moves easily through the arctic waters it calls home.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is often seen crawling around in volcanic regions.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.flavorText: It is very small and powerless. If attacked, the best it can do is flap its leaves in an attempt to frighten away its enemies.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavorText: It moves with its sensitive nose pressed to the ground, always searching for food.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: Its highly developed jaws are powerful enough to crush anything. Even experienced adult trainers must handle it with great caution.

cards.name: Unown [L]
cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [S]
cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [T]
cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Unown [V]
cards.flavorText: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavorText: It possesses a type of radar, which it can use to find the insects it eats for food, even in pitch darkness.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: As it grows older, its white tail changes colors and splits into six different tails. Its body radiates a faint warmth.

cards.name: Shining Celebi
cards.flavorText: It is worshipped as a god of the forest. It appears only in undisturbed old-growth forests.

cards.name: Shining Charizard
cards.flavorText: The flames it breathes are so hot that they can melt anything.

cards.name: Shining Kabutops
cards.flavorText: This ancient Pokémon uses its razor-sharp claws to cut open its prey and gain access to its blood.

cards.name: Shining Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: It uses its highly developed psychic powers to defeat its enemies before they even have time to think.

cards.name: Shining Noctowl
cards.flavorText: It speeds up its thought processes by turning its head around 180 degrees.

cards.name: Shining Raichu
cards.flavorText: If the electricity in its cheeks runs out, it sticks its tail straight up and uses it to collect energy from the air.

cards.name: Shining Steelix
cards.flavorText: If an Onix lives 100 years or more, its skin hardens, eventually becoming even harder than a diamond.

cards.name: Shining Tyranitar
cards.flavorText: It is so powerful, it can knock down a mountain with hust one arm.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.flavorText: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.flavorText: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Radiant Venusaur
cards.flavorText: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.flavorText: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.flavorText: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

cards.name: Radiant Charizard
cards.flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.flavorText: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

cards.name: Radiant Blastoise
cards.flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won't feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won't notice when its tail grows back, either.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.flavorText: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

cards.name: Sylveon
cards.flavorText: By releasing enmity-erasing waves from its ribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

cards.name: Alolan Rattata
cards.flavorText: Night after night, they sneak into people's homes seeking food. A massive outbreak of them has become an issue of public concern.

cards.name: Alolan Raticate
cards.flavorText: It commands a nest of Rattata. Different nests don't get along, whipping up severe fights over feeding grounds.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.flavorText: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

cards.name: Meltan
cards.flavorText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

cards.name: Melmetal
cards.flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It's used as a high-class cooking ingredient.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.flavorText: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokémon is all better.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.flavorText: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.flavorText: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.flavorText: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.flavorText: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

cards.name: Professor's Research
cards.flavorText: Professor Willow

cards.name: Professor's Research
cards.flavorText: Professor Willow

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.flavorText: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga's heart beats.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.flavorText: It uses unique fighting moves with fires on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.flavorText: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.flavorText: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.flavorText: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA's every breath.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.flavorText: Some Pokémon are born on a TORTERRA's back and spend their entire life there.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.flavorText: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.flavorText: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

cards.name: Cranidos
cards.flavorText: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.flavorText: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.flavorText: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.flavorText: It skillfully control the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.flavorText: Because every PRINPLUP considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.flavorText: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

cards.name: Shieldon
cards.flavorText: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.flavorText: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.flavorText: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still even for a moment.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.flavorText: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive 30 days without water.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

cards.name: Combee
cards.flavorText: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays. It appears among filth.

cards.name: Happiny
cards.flavorText: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others' feet and cause them to stumble.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.flavorText: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: When it extends its over-six-foot-long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.flavorText: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.flavorText: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with persistent nature, it chases its prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the REMORAID is deep in the sea.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.flavorText: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.flavorText: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, the shell should feel moist.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.flavorText: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

cards.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-101 Energy Gain
Team Galactic's Invention G-103 Power Spray
Team Galactic's Invention G-105 Poké Turn
Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavorText: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It stops eating only to sleep. It doesn't feel full unless it eats nearly 900 pounds a day.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.flavorText: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: They swarm any foes that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.flavorText: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.flavorText: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.

cards.name: Munchlax
cards.flavorText: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

cards.name: Munchlax
cards.flavorText: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.flavorText: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.flavorText: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO's.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.flavorText: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.flavorText: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.flavorText: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Shellos East Sea
cards.flavorText: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

cards.name: Shellos West Sea
cards.flavorText: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.flavorText: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

cards.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-107 Technical Machine G
Team Galactic's Invention G-109 SP Radar
Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

cards.name: Flying Pikachu
cards.flavorText: By learning how to fly, Pikachu overcame its weakness to Fighting Pokémon.

cards.name: Surfing Pikachu
cards.flavorText: One summer, a group of Pikachu was found riding the waves at the local beach.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.flavorText: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.flavorText: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.flavorText: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.flavorText: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.flavorText: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.flavorText: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.flavorText: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: A mushroom grown larger than the host's body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.flavorText: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.flavorText: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

cards.name: Shedinja
cards.flavorText: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.flavorText: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.flavorText: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.flavorText: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.flavorText: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.flavorText: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.flavorText: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

cards.name: Loudred
cards.flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.

cards.name: Marshtomp
cards.flavorText: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.flavorText: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.flavorText: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

cards.name: Minun
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

cards.name: Ninjask
cards.flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.flavorText: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.flavorText: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.flavorText: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavorText: It can hover is one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.flavorText: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

cards.name: Chingling
cards.flavorText: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

cards.name: Combee
cards.flavorText: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.flavorText: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

cards.name: Feebas
cards.flavorText: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.flavorText: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.flavorText: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.flavorText: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

cards.name: Mime Jr.
cards.flavorText: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Nincada
cards.flavorText: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.flavorText: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.flavorText: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.

cards.name: Starly
cards.flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.

cards.name: Whismur
cards.flavorText: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to freeze the water in the air during winter, causing snow.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: The flames on this legendary Pokémon's wings burn so brightly that they can make night seem like day.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to be present wherever there is a lightning storm.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.flavorText: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavorText: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.flavorText: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.flavorText: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

cards.name: Mothim
cards.flavorText: While it loves floral honey, it won't gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.

cards.name: Swalot
cards.flavorText: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for more potency.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.flavorText: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.flavorText: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.flavorText: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.flavorText: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

cards.name: Sceptile
cards.flavorText: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavorText: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Gulpin
cards.flavorText: Almost all of its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

cards.name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
cards.flavorText: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.

cards.name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
cards.flavorText: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.

cards.name: Wormadam Trash Cloak
cards.flavorText: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

cards.name: Burmy Plant Cloak
cards.flavorText: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.

cards.name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
cards.flavorText: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.

cards.name: Burmy Trash Cloak
cards.flavorText: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.flavorText: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

cards.name: Gulpin
cards.flavorText: Almost all of its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.flavorText: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.flavorText: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.flavorText: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.flavorText: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.flavorText: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.flavorText: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Arceus
cards.flavorText: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

cards.name: Arceus
cards.flavorText: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.

cards.name: Arceus
cards.flavorText: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

cards.name: Arceus
cards.flavorText: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.
