cards.name: Arceus
cards.flavorText: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

cards.name: Bastiodon
cards.flavorText: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

cards.name: Rampardos
cards.flavorText: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.flavorText: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling is rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: It agilely scales cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Starly
cards.flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.flavorText: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on it elbows.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

cards.name: Mothim
cards.flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.flavorText: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fire hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer's feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.flavorText: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

cards.name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
cards.flavorText: When BURMY evolved, it cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Burmy Plant Cloak
cards.flavorText: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

cards.name: Burmy Sandy Cloak
cards.flavorText: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.flavorText: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can't live in polluted waters.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: It uses the horns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.

cards.name: Sentret
cards.flavorText: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.flavorText: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey–even those taking shelter behind a wall.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.flavorText: It exudes strong magnetism from all cover. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.flavorText: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.flavorText: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

cards.name: Happiny
cards.flavorText: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: Its body is lithe yet powerful. It can crest three mountains and cross two canyons in one night.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: It habitually digs up and hoards gems in its nest. Its loot is constantly targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.flavorText: It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It live atop trees.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.flavorText: It plays with others by touching tails and setting off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: Its nests is small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.flavorText: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

cards.name: Sawsbuck
cards.flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.flavorText: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

cards.name: Accelgor
cards.flavorText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.flavorText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Dewott
cards.flavorText: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

cards.name: Samurott
cards.flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

cards.name: Basculin
cards.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.flavorText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.flavorText: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

cards.name: Frillish
cards.flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

cards.name: Roggenrola
cards.flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

cards.name: Boldore
cards.flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

cards.name: Gigalith
cards.flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.flavorText: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

cards.name: Archen
cards.flavorText: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.flavorText: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

cards.name: Mienshao
cards.flavorText: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.flavorText: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.flavorText: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

cards.name: Deino
cards.flavorText: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.flavorText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

cards.name: Durant
cards.flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.flavorText: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.flavorText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.flavorText: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.flavorText: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

cards.name: Deino
cards.flavorText: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.flavorText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.flavorText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

cards.name: Durant
cards.flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.flavorText: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.flavorText: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's body is covered by fine hairs that can be seen only under a microscope.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon searches for food while flying at Mach 2. Its large claws make fearsome weapons.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon burrows through the earth at high speed, looking for food. The tunnels it digs are used by Diglett as nests.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is still immature. When threatened, it releases poison from its head and tries to drive its enemies away.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.flavorText: A sure sign spring is on its way is when the seed on this Pokémon's back flowers.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon sometimes hunts for food in rivers, swimming using the small webs between the toes on its rear legs.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.flavorText: When it senses enemies approaching, this Pokémon releases an orange fluid from the joints in its legs and flees.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: After lulling its enemies with its large eyes, this Pokémon sings them to sleep with a relaxing melody.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: The poison scales on its wings are waterproof, allowing this Pokémon to be active even on rainy days.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon attacks its prey with its eighty toxin-producing tentacles.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's fur repels water like a duck's feathers, allowing it to stay dry and fluffy even in water.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: This gentle Pokémon can understand human language and allows people to ride on its back.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a unique cry, as all three of its heads are always talking independently of one another.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.flavorText: Its nonchalant reaction to everything somehow gives this Pokémon an imposing presence.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon withdraws into its shell, although it can't quite pull in all of its long tail.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its six-foot tongue as if it were a hand. The origin of its anaesthetic properties is still a mystery.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes a loud jangling noise when it shakes its petals to spread poison powder.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon only calms down when there are no other animals or people around—which means no one has ever seen it when it's not angry.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its heads. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.flavorText: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.flavorText: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

cards.name: Decidueye
cards.flavorText: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Fomantis
cards.flavorText: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.flavorText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

cards.name: Shiinotic
cards.flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.flavorText: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

cards.name: Steenee
cards.flavorText: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.flavorText: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mounts where they live.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

cards.name: Incineroar
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who posses one, so it was over-hunted in the past.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavorText: It's still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokémon to walk every day.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavorText: It marches over the land in search of bug Pokémon to eat. Then it takes them underwater so it can dine on them where it's safe.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.flavorText: Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.flavorText: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.flavorText: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.flavorText: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean sure to be is teeming with fish Pokémon.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.flavorText: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Brionne
cards.flavorText: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards it enemies.

cards.name: Primarina
cards.flavorText: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learning from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.flavorText: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.flavorText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

cards.name: Pyukumuku
cards.flavorText: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.flavorText: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.flavorText: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes, so to check its surroundings while flying, it emits ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can't move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.flavorText: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

cards.name: Alolan Muk
cards.flavorText: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: It finds really fun dreams tasty. When it makes friends with people, it may show them the most delicious dreams it's ever eaten.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: As a matter of course, it makes anyone it meets fall asleep and has a taste of their dreams. Anyone having a good dream, it carries off.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.flavorText: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.flavorText: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.flavorText: It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.flavorText: It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it grows older, it focuses more on training Makuhita.

cards.name: Roggenrola
cards.flavorText: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

cards.name: Boldore
cards.flavorText: It explores caves in search of underground water. It's not comfortable around water, so this Pokémon takes great care in lapping it up.

cards.name: Gigalith
cards.flavorText: Known for its hefty horsepower, this Pokémon is a popular partner for construction workers.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.flavorText: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.flavorText: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.flavorText: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.

cards.name: Alolan Rattata
cards.flavorText: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for the boss of its nest—Raticate.

cards.name: Alolan Raticate
cards.flavorText: This gourmet Pokémon is particular about the taste and freshness of its food. Restaurants where Raticate live have a good reputation.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

cards.name: Alolan Persian
cards.flavorText: Its round face and smooth coat—softer than the most high-class velvet—have made this a very popular Pokémon in Alola.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: If they scent the faintest trace of blood, they rush to attack en masse. When alone, they're rather cowardly.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: It has a sad history. In the past, its dorsal fin was a treasured foodstuff, so this Pokémon became a victim of overfishing.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.flavorText: They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.flavorText: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett
cards.flavorText: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.flavorText: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

cards.name: Ribombee
cards.flavorText: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: From time immemorial, it has been venerated by agricultural peoples as an entity able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: Incur the wrath of this normally calm Pokémon at your peril, because it will smash everything to smithereens before it's satisfied.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: Farmers whose fields are troubled by bug Pokémon appreciate Spearow for its vigorous appetite and look after it.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: Drawings of a Pokémon resembling Fearow can be seen in murals from deep in ancient history.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: Kangaskhan's maternal love is so deep that it will brave death to protect its offspring.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.flavorText: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it's walking in a straight line.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.flavorText: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed make this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.flavorText: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it's a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.

cards.name: Pikipek
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

cards.name: Trumbeak
cards.flavorText: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of call and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

cards.name: Toucannon
cards.flavorText: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.flavorText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.flavorText: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.flavorText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: If you find its nest, you shouldn't stick your hand inside. You'll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.

cards.name: Kartana
cards.flavorText: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: While it's quite friendly toward humans once it's grown used to them, in the wild it must be quite fierce to defend its territory from Rockruff.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.flavorText: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.flavorText: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.

cards.name: Incineroar
cards.flavorText: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

cards.name: Blacephalon
cards.flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavorText: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavorText: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavorText: Although it has become capable of living on land, it spends its time in the water, where its prey, fish Pokémon, are plentiful.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.flavorText: It's quite a gifted swimmer, even among Water-type Pokémon, but it normally spends its time on land.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.flavorText: It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It's especially fond of Wishiwashi.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.flavorText: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

cards.name: Kingler
cards.flavorText: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.flavorText: Although known for their splendid tail fins, Goldeen apparently compete among themselves to see whose horn is thickest and sharpest.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.flavorText: Its horn spins like a drill to steadily hollow out rocks—even harder ones. The coloration of the male is more vivid.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

cards.name: Pyukumuku
cards.flavorText: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.flavorText: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.flavorText: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.flavorText: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: It has no eyeballs, so it can't see. It checks its surroundings via the ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: Every once in a while, you'll see a Golbat that's missing some fangs. This happens when hunger drives it to try biting a Steel-type Pokémon.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won't notice any pain or realize you've been bitten.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: On moonless nights, Haunter searches for someone to curse, so it's best not to go out walking around.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: You can hear tales told all over the world about how Gengar will pay a visit to children who are naughty.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: It can be spotted near recreational facilities, intending to eat the pleasant dreams of children who enjoyed themselves there that day.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: In Alola, Komala is Hypno's main target. It rarely harms people.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: What gives meaning to its life is surprising others. If you set your ear against the red orbs around its neck, you can hear shrieking.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.flavorText: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.flavorText: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.flavorText: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.flavorText: It travels through tunnels that it digs underground. It hates sunlight, so it comes out only after the sun goes down.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavorText: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

cards.name: Golem
cards.flavorText: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.flavorText: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It's thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.flavorText: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavorText: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

cards.name: Tyrogue
cards.flavorText: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.flavorText: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.flavorText: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

cards.name: Stakataka
cards.flavorText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: People believe that carrying one of its discarded fangs will prevent mishaps at sea, so the fangs are made into accessories.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.flavorText: Krokorok really hates it when its body gets cold. On nights when the temperature drops, it digs deep into the desert sands.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.flavorText: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there's an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett
cards.flavorText: Although it's powerful enough to dig right through volcanic rock, it doesn't allow itself to be seen very often.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it's not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.flavorText: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.flavorText: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

cards.name: Meltan
cards.flavorText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

cards.name: Melmetal
cards.flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavorText: On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.flavorText: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

cards.name: Spritzee
cards.flavorText: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

cards.name: Aromatisse
cards.flavorText: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.flavorText: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.flavorText: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: AI has been installed in it. It learns various things all on its own, but it even remembers things it doesn't need to know.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: Its behavior is noticeably unstable, which is apparently due to the incompetence of the engineer who updated its programming.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.flavorText: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.flavorText: It would claim another Pokémon's nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

cards.name: Happiny
cards.flavorText: Usually it's a well-behaved Pokémon, but if you take its round rock away, it will cry and fuss and throw a big old tantrum.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.flavorText: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavorText: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.flavorText: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.flavorText: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.flavorText: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.flavorText: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

cards.name: Fomantis
cards.flavorText: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.

cards.name: Lurantis
cards.flavorText: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.flavorText: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.

cards.name: Steenee
cards.flavorText: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.flavorText: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.flavorText: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: There are still quite a few factories that rely on the flames provided by Magmortar to process metals.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.flavorText: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.flavorText: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.flavorText: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.

cards.name: Finneon
cards.flavorText: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

cards.name: Lumineon
cards.flavorText: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.

cards.name: Snover
cards.flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.flavorText: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."

cards.name: Basculin
cards.flavorText: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

cards.name: Tirtouga
cards.flavorText: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.

cards.name: Carracosta
cards.flavorText: Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.flavorText: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.flavorText: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.

cards.name: Pyukumuku
cards.flavorText: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

cards.name: Tapu Fini
cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Alolan Raichu
cards.flavorText: It focuses psychic energy into its tail and rides it like it's surfing. Another name for this Pokémon is "hodad."

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: It uses radar to monitor its territory. Intruders are quickly disposed of with a hyper beam.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.flavorText: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.flavorText: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

cards.name: Xurkitree
cards.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: It engages its enemies using psychic powers. Each of its three heads fires off psychokinetic energy, tripling its power.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak
cards.flavorText: The rich greenery of the Alola region is hard on Marowak. It controls fire to stay alive.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Wynaut
cards.flavorText: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: Its round body is stuffed with souls and expands each time it leads someone away.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: There's a rumor that if you catch a Drifblim floating on the wind at dusk, you'll be carried away to the afterlife.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Munna
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.flavorText: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.flavorText: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents' memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.flavorText: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.flavorText: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.flavorText: They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.flavorText: To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

cards.name: Necrozma
cards.flavorText: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

cards.name: Poipole
cards.flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.flavorText: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.flavorText: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.flavorText: Thought to have gone extinct, Relicanth was given a name that is a variation of the name of the person who discovered it.

cards.name: Gible
