cards.flavorText: It reacts to anything that moves—flies right at it and bites it. Sometimes it injures itself, but it doesn't care too much.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: It loves shiny things. When it finds a Sableye trying to catch a Carbink, Gabite becomes furiously angry and attacks the Sableye.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Archen
cards.flavorText: Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.flavorText: This ancient Pokémon's plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent's chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.flavorText: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It digs through the ground with its hard claws and crunches down gems with its thick pointy teeth. Carbink is its favorite food.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.flavorText: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.flavorText: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.flavorText: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.flavorText: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: It sneaks into people's homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it's the handiwork of this rascal.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.flavorText: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: Fruits are its favorite foods. This gourmet carefully picks out just the ripe ones using its sonar.

cards.name: Noivern
cards.flavorText: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.flavorText: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.flavorText: Every day, it tilts its head in the same rhythm. A long time ago, people raised these Pokémon to serve as clocks.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: With eyes that can see in pitch-darkness, it never lets its prey escape. Some even call it "the emperor of dark nights."

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.flavorText: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.flavorText: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.flavorText: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.flavorText: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

cards.name: Munchlax
cards.flavorText: It hides food under its long fur, but it sometimes forgets about it and causes a stinky disturbance.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.flavorText: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.flavorText: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

cards.name: Audino
cards.flavorText: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.flavorText: While it's an amiable Pokémon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you'll be burned.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.flavorText: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.

cards.name: Gumshoos
cards.flavorText: Although it wasn't originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

cards.name: Type: Null
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

cards.name: Silvally
cards.flavorText: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

cards.name: Komala
cards.flavorText: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.flavorText: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavorText: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

cards.name: Golem
cards.flavorText: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: It seems that other Pokémon's efforts to take its delicious, nutritious egg away from it caused Chansey to get faster at fleeing.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.flavorText: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.flavorText: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon's face become more vivid and lively.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.

cards.name: Lileep
cards.flavorText: In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.

cards.name: Cradily
cards.flavorText: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.flavorText: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.flavorText: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.flavorText: Their coloring changes according to the season and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

cards.name: Sawsbuck
cards.flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.flavorText: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.

cards.name: Decidueye
cards.flavorText: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

cards.name: Buzzwole
cards.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: If it inhales deeply, that's a sign it's about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.flavorText: When they're young, they live with a pride. Once they're able to hunt prey on their own, they're kicked out and have to make their own way.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.flavorText: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.flavorText: If you carelessly approach it because it's cute, the boss of the pack, Ninetales, will appear and freeze you.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: It swims along with its mouth open and swallows down seawater along with its food. It sprays excess water out of its nostrils.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: They eat so many fish Pokémon that when Wailord become too numerous, fishermen have to chase them off.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.flavorText: It freezes its prey and chews them whole. However, it prefers to eat Pokémon like Vanillite that are already frozen.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.flavorText: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.flavorText: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.flavorText: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

cards.name: Phione
cards.flavorText: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.flavorText: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.flavorText: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

cards.name: Black Kyurem
cards.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.flavorText: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.flavorText: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: When the bacteria living inside its antennae absorb Lanturn's bodily fluids, a strong luminescent effect is produced.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: Although it still can't fly, its jumping power is outstanding. It jumps way up into trees and plucks the buds from the branches.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: It's said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it's not powerful enough to change the future it sees.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.flavorText: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.flavorText: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.flavorText: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

cards.name: Golett
cards.flavorText: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.flavorText: Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master's orders faithfully.

cards.name: Skrelp
cards.flavorText: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.

cards.name: Dragalge
cards.flavorText: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.flavorText: By imitating the voice of a child, it causes people to get hopelessly lost deep in the forest. It's trying to make friends with them.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.flavorText: It's feared as a ghost of the forest. Lumberjacks bring along Fire types, which Trevenant hates, when they enter the forest.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.flavorText: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.flavorText: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the "cocoon of the stars" and built an altar to worship it.

cards.name: Lunala
cards.flavorText: Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name "the beast that calls the moon."

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.flavorText: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

cards.name: Blacephalon
cards.flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.flavorText: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it's in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.flavorText: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.flavorText: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.flavorText: It vibrates its wings to generate ultrasonic waves, causing its prey to faint. Then it buries the prey alive in the sand to preserve it.

cards.name: Anorith
cards.flavorText: When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don't thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.

cards.name: Armaldo
cards.flavorText: It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.flavorText: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

cards.name: Throh
cards.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.flavorText: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.flavorText: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: It has no problem ignoring orders it doesn't like. It doesn't seem to mind getting hurt at all—as long as it can finish off its opponent.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.flavorText: They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.flavorText: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.flavorText: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they're still alive.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.flavorText: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.flavorText: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

cards.name: Alolan Muk
cards.flavorText: There are over a hundred kinds of poison inside its body. Chemical reactions between different poisons are the source of its vitality.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: The only thing unlucky about Absol is its appearance. It protects fields and warns people of disaster, so one ought to be grateful for it.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it's said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.

cards.name: Guzzlord
cards.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: After fleeing a volcanic eruption, it ended up moving to an area of snowy mountains. Its ice shell is as hard as steel.

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash
cards.flavorText: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.flavorText: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don't come back.

cards.name: Solgaleo
cards.flavorText: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales
cards.flavorText: The reason it guides people all the way down to the mountain's base is that it wants them to hurry up and leave.

cards.name: Azurill
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.flavorText: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.flavorText: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.flavorText: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

cards.name: Floette
cards.flavorText: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.

cards.name: Florges
cards.flavorText: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.flavorText: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

cards.name: Sylveon
cards.flavorText: Once a fight breaks out, it will unflinchingly charge at dragon Pokémon that are many times larger than itself.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully's house and burn it to the ground.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

cards.name: Hakamo-o
cards.flavorText: It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.

cards.name: Kommo-o
cards.flavorText: When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.

cards.name: Ultra Necrozma
cards.flavorText: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Igglybuff
cards.flavorText: It's always practicing its singing because it wants to improve. Even when it's asleep, it keeps singing in its dreams!

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.flavorText: In their search for comfortable trees, they get into territorial disputes with groups of Passimian. They win about half the time.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.flavorText: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has excellent judgment. If it decides it can't defeat an opponent, it immediately turns tail and vamooses.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.flavorText: The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can't easily penetrate it.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.flavorText: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.flavorText: With its powerful legs and sturdy claws, it can crack even the hard shells of Shellder and pluck out their insides.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.flavorText: The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it's considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.flavorText: It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn't run away as fast as possible.

cards.name: Type: Null
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.flavorText: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.flavorText: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.flavorText: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.flavorText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.flavorText: Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.flavorText: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in the forest, it offers great kindness.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.flavorText: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard—so much so, it can't roll its body up into a ball.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard—so much so, it can't roll its body up into a ball.

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash
cards.flavorText: Fleeing a volcanic eruption, it settled on a snowy mountain. As it races through the snowfields, it sends up a spray of snow.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: They can be found lying dehydrated on beaches, but they are often still alive. When soaked in water, they will revive.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles. The longer one has been alive, the fewer tentacles it will have.

cards.name: Politoed
cards.flavorText: They gather on moonlit nights to form a large chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.flavorText: Although it naturally prefers colder locales, Delibird in Alola seem able to withstand the heat to a certain extent.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: Each school has its own territory. Any intruders are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron. It is known as the bully of the sea.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: It loves to startle people. It fills itself up with seawater and plays by bouncing around like a ball.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: Wailord pursue their prey in pods. With their large mouths, they can swallow entire schools of Wishiwashi whole.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt live will be prosperous for generations to come.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.flavorText: Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain absorbed the distress and regrets of a stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.flavorText: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.flavorText: Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be restored by refreezing it, but the process leaves its body slightly warped.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.flavorText: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.flavorText: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.flavorText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude
cards.flavorText: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

cards.name: Alolan Graveler
cards.flavorText: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

cards.name: Alolan Golem
cards.flavorText: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped bright yellow nectar. Its bright, cheerful dance melts the hearts of its enemies.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn't really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn't particularly bothered.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: It spaces out while gazing at the sea. With Shellder's poison flowing through its body, it becomes even spacier.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Its elegant, attractive dance will send the minds and hearts of its enemies to another world.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by horror and died of the shock.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.flavorText: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

cards.name: Lunala
cards.flavorText: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.flavorText: As a result of its continual workouts, it has developed tremendous power. It uses that power to help people with their work.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: It unleashes megaton-level punches that send opponents flying clear over the horizon.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.flavorText: The magnet in Nosepass's nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.flavorText: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.flavorText: A glutton that devours anything that moves, it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps, lying in wait for prey.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

cards.name: Mudbray
cards.flavorText: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.flavorText: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

cards.name: Minior
cards.flavorText: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, "Get home before the Murkrow fly."

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It's a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink. Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs them first.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.flavorText: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.flavorText: It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.

cards.name: Solgaleo
cards.flavorText: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: Its adorable behavior and appearance make it popular with men and women, young and old. Its numbers are few, however.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: They don't like to reveal themselves in front of people. They live quietly in packs deep in the mountains.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.flavorText: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

cards.name: Comfey
cards.flavorText: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.flavorText: The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, it's unable to breathe if its skin dries out, so it sticks to shady places.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.flavorText: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.flavorText: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it will completely destroy its surroundings with its intense breath.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

cards.name: Hakamo-o
cards.flavorText: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.flavorText: Even the most ferocious Pokémon become calm when they eat Blissey's egg, which is said to be filled with happiness.

cards.name: Taillow
cards.flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

cards.name: Swellow
cards.flavorText: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

cards.name: Castform
cards.flavorText: It changes its form depending on the weather. Changes in the temperature or humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.flavorText: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.flavorText: From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.flavorText: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Komala
cards.flavorText: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.flavorText: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.flavorText: While it's believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.flavorText: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales
cards.flavorText: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavorText: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.flavorText: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.flavorText: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.flavorText: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.flavorText: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

cards.name: Venipede
cards.flavorText: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

cards.name: Whirlipede
cards.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

cards.name: Scolipede
cards.flavorText: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.flavorText: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.flavorText: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.flavorText: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.flavorText: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.flavorText: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.flavorText: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: The more intimidating the opponent it faces, the more this Pokémon's blood boils. It will attack with no regard for its own safety.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

cards.name: Mudbray
cards.flavorText: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.flavorText: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.flavorText: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

cards.name: Alolan Rattata
cards.flavorText: With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and infiltrates people's homes. Then, with a twitch of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.

cards.name: Alolan Raticate
cards.flavorText: It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.flavorText: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.flavorText: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.flavorText: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

cards.name: Ribombee
cards.flavorText: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.flavorText: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

cards.name: Shiinotic
cards.flavorText: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: For the purposes of planetary development, Porygon was updated with the most cutting-edge technology available.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.flavorText: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.flavorText: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.flavorText: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.flavorText: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

cards.name: Shining Genesect
cards.flavorText: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.flavorText: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

cards.name: Incineroar
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.flavorText: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.flavorText: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Keldeo
