cards.flavorText: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

cards.name: Shining Volcanion
cards.flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Raikou
cards.flavorText: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Minun
cards.flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.flavorText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

cards.name: Shining Mew
cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

cards.name: Shining Jirachi
cards.flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

cards.name: Golett
cards.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.flavorText: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.flavorText: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.flavorText: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.flavorText: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

cards.name: Shining Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Shining Arceus
cards.flavorText: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.flavorText: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.flavorText: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

cards.name: Accelgor
cards.flavorText: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.flavorText: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak
cards.flavorText: The bones it possesses were once its mother's. Its mother's regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.flavorText: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.flavorText: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

cards.name: Crawdaunt
cards.flavorText: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.flavorText: A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn't popular.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

cards.name: Regice
cards.flavorText: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can't be melted, even by magma.

cards.name: Shellos
cards.flavorText: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Alolan Raichu
cards.flavorText: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude
cards.flavorText: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

cards.name: Alolan Graveler
cards.flavorText: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: It appears as if from nowhere—muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.flavorText: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.flavorText: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo
cards.flavorText: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

cards.name: Gourgeist
cards.flavorText: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

cards.name: Gastrodon
cards.flavorText: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

cards.name: Deino
cards.flavorText: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.flavorText: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.flavorText: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.flavorText: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

cards.name: Registeel
cards.flavorText: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.flavorText: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you'll become sleepy right away.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: It sheds its fine fur when the seasons change. The fur is gathered and spun into a luxurious yarn.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.flavorText: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

cards.name: Hakamo-o
cards.flavorText: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

cards.name: Kommo-o
cards.flavorText: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.flavorText: Its milk is high in calories and packed with nutrients. Therefore, if you drink too much of it, you may wind up with a body like Miltank's.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

cards.name: Starly
cards.flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.flavorText: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.flavorText: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.flavorText: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

cards.name: Type: Null
cards.flavorText: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.flavorText: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.flavorText: With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.flavorText: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.name: Mow Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: When angered, it spouts brilliant fire from all over its body. It doesn't calm down until its opponent has burned to ash.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: From its arm, it launches fireballs hotter than 3,500 degrees Fahrenheit. Its arm starts to melt when it fires a whole barrage.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.flavorText: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.flavorText: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

cards.name: Heat Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: Volcanoes or dry, craggy places are its home. It emanates a sweet-smelling poisonous gas that attracts bug Pokémon, then attacks them.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.flavorText: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance and can be put to various uses.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's steel spikes are sheathed in ice. Stabs from these spikes cause deep wounds and severe frostbite as well.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.flavorText: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.flavorText: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

cards.name: Snover
cards.flavorText: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.flavorText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

cards.name: Wash Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Frost Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Electricity leaks from it in amounts far greater than the amount of electricity it eats.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: If for some reason its body bursts, its soul spills out with a screaming sound.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: Even while under careful observation, large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk will inexplicably disappear from view.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.flavorText: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.flavorText: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

cards.name: Giratina ◇
cards.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.flavorText: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.flavorText: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

cards.name: Lunala ◇
cards.flavorText: Said to live in another world, this Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.

cards.name: Cranidos
cards.flavorText: In rock layers where Cranidos fossils are found, the fossilized trunks of trees snapped in two are also often found.

cards.name: Rampardos
cards.flavorText: Records exist of a revived fossil that evolved into Rampardos. It proceeded to escape and then destroy a skyscraper with a headbutt.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It's tough enough to run right through the night, and it's also a hard worker, but it's still just a youngster.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.flavorText: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.flavorText: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.flavorText: They battle with hard berries for weapons. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: Seen as a symbol of bad luck, it's generally disliked. Yet it gives presents—objects that sparkle or shine—to Trainers it's close to.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: If its Murkrow cronies fail to catch food for it, or if it feels they have betrayed it, it will hunt them down wherever they are and punish them.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: It uses its claws to poke holes in eggs so it can slurp out the insides. Breeders consider it a scourge and will drive it away or eradicate it.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: They dwell in cold places. This Pokémon's main food source in Alola is Vulpix and Sandshrew, which they carefully divide among their group.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.flavorText: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

cards.name: Skuntank
cards.flavorText: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

cards.name: Darkrai ◇
cards.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett
cards.flavorText: Its golden hairs function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

cards.name: Shieldon
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. Few enemies would have been willing to square off against its heavily armored face, so it's thought.

cards.name: Bastiodon
cards.flavorText: It lived in the same environments as Rampardos. Their fossils have been found together—seemingly from after they'd fought to the finish.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Solgaleo ◇
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.

cards.name: Magearna
cards.flavorText: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.flavorText: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

cards.name: Shiinotic
cards.flavorText: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

cards.name: Tapu Lele
cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: Alola is the best environment for this Pokémon. Local people take pride in its appearance, saying this is how Exeggutor ought to look.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.flavorText: Their saliva contains lots of components that can dissolve anything. The numbness caused by their lick does not dissipate.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.flavorText: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.flavorText: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.flavorText: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

cards.name: Fan Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.flavorText: It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.

cards.name: Gumshoos
cards.flavorText: It adores having Rattata and Raticate for dinner, but as it's diurnal, it never encounters them. This Pokémon boasts incredible patience.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

cards.name: Type: Null
cards.flavorText: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Six of them together form a full-fledged Pokémon. It's often hunted by Crabrawler, but uses psychokinesis to drive it off.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

cards.name: Snover
cards.flavorText: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.flavorText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

cards.name: Spewpa
cards.flavorText: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

cards.name: Vivillon
cards.flavorText: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.flavorText: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.flavorText: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

cards.name: Pheromosa
cards.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak
cards.flavorText: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.flavorText: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

cards.name: Delphox
cards.flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degree Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.flavorText: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.flavorText: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

cards.name: Clawitzer
cards.flavorText: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

cards.name: Amaura
cards.flavorText: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.

cards.name: Aurorus
cards.flavorText: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack.

cards.name: Bergmite
cards.flavorText: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.

cards.name: Avalugg
cards.flavorText: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

cards.name: Volcanion ◇
cards.flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.flavorText: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

cards.name: Xurkitree
cards.flavorText: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.flavorText: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.flavorText: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.flavorText: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf all came from the same egg.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.flavorText: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.flavorText: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.flavorText: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.flavorText: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

cards.name: Skrelp
cards.flavorText: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

cards.name: Dragalge
cards.flavorText: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.flavorText: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

cards.name: Poipole
cards.flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.flavorText: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

cards.name: Binacle
cards.flavorText: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

cards.name: Barbaracle
cards.flavorText: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

cards.name: Tyrunt
cards.flavorText: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.

cards.name: Tyrantrum
cards.flavorText: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.flavorText: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: This is Zygarde's form when about 10% of its cells have been gathered. It runs across the land at speeds greater than 60 mph.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

cards.name: Diancie ◇
cards.flavorText: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

cards.name: Buzzwole
cards.flavorText: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.flavorText: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

cards.name: Guzzlord
cards.flavorText: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.flavorText: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.flavorText: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

cards.name: Floette
cards.flavorText: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

cards.name: Florges
cards.flavorText: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

cards.name: Sylveon
cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon sights its prey, it swirls its ribbonlike feelers as a distraction. A moment later, it pounces.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.flavorText: It inserts its horn into chinks in metal, absorbing metal ions. For some reason, it collects keys.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.flavorText: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.flavorText: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it needs some thorough hand-washing.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.flavorText: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

cards.name: Arceus ◇
cards.flavorText: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.flavorText: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.flavorText: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.

cards.name: Furfrou
cards.flavorText: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Noivern
cards.flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It swoops out of the dark to attack.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.flavorText: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.flavorText: Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.flavorText: It spins thread from both its rear and its mouth. Then it wraps its prey up in thread and sips their bodily fluids at its leisure.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Sceptile
cards.flavorText: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

cards.name: Sceptile
cards.flavorText: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.flavorText: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its head. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.flavorText: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

cards.name: Volbeat
cards.flavorText: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

cards.name: Illumise
cards.flavorText: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.flavorText: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.flavorText: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.flavorText: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.flavorText: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.flavorText: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: If the fire burning within its shell goes out, it will die. Those who wish to raise one in their home must always keep something flammable at hand.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its passionate dance moves cause its enemies to combust in both body and mind.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Marshtomp
cards.flavorText: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

cards.name: Swampert
cards.flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.flavorText: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.flavorText: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.flavorText: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

cards.name: Clamperl
cards.flavorText: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

cards.name: Huntail
cards.flavorText: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

cards.name: Gorebyss
cards.flavorText: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.flavorText: Loving couples have a soft spot for this Pokémon, so honeymoon hotels often release this Pokémon into their pools.

cards.name: Regice
cards.flavorText: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Minun
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: It creates an electric charge by rubbing its feathers together. It dances over to its enemies and delivers shocking electrical punches.

cards.name: Gulpin
cards.flavorText: There is nothing its stomach can't digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

cards.name: Swalot
cards.flavorText: It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.flavorText: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.name: Banette
cards.flavorText: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Lunala
cards.flavorText: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.flavorText: It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.flavorText: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

cards.name: Minior
cards.flavorText: Strong impacts can knock it out of its shell. This Pokémon was born from mutated nanoparticles.

cards.name: Alolan Rattata
cards.flavorText: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for the boss of its nest—Raticate.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: It uses its claws to poke holes in eggs so it can slurp out the insides. Breeders consider it a scourge and will drive it away or eradicate it.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: With magnetic traction, it pulls its opponents in close. When they're in range, it slashes them with its rear claws.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: With magnetic traction, it pulls its opponents in close. When they're in range, it slashes them with its rear claws.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.flavorText: A linkage of two Metang, this Pokémon can perform any calculation in a flash by utilizing parallel processing in its four brains.

cards.name: Registeel
cards.flavorText: Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal. A study has revealed that its body is hollow.

cards.name: Jirachi ◇
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Solgaleo
cards.flavorText: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

cards.name: Celesteela
cards.flavorText: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

cards.name: Kartana
cards.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.flavorText: They lurk deep within caves—motionless, neither eating nor drinking. Why they don't die is not known.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.flavorText: It flies around on its wings, which have grown in at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames, burning up the fields it passes over.

cards.name: Latias ◇
cards.flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.name: Latios ◇
cards.flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.flavorText: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean is sure to be teeming with fish Pokémon.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.flavorText: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.flavorText: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.flavorText: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.flavorText: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

cards.name: Whismur
cards.flavorText: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

cards.name: Whismur
cards.flavorText: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

cards.name: Loudred
cards.flavorText: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

cards.name: Exploud
cards.flavorText: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor—or like an earthquake has struck.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.flavorText: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Blaziken
cards.flavorText: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

cards.name: Victini ◇
cards.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.flavorText: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: Volcanoes or dry, craggy places are its home. It emanates a sweet-smelling poisonous gas that attracts bug Pokémon, then attacks them.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: Its reckless leaps make it easy pickings for predators. On the bright side, many Pokémon enjoy longer life spans, thanks to Magikarp.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: There are people who swear that any place Gyarados appears is fated for destruction.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.flavorText: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavorText: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavorText: This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.flavorText: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.flavorText: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.flavorText: It lives at the bottom of clear lakes. In times of war, it shows itself, which soothes people's minds and hearts.

cards.name: Phione
cards.flavorText: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.flavorText: It's awfully weak and notably tasty, so everyone is always out to get it. As it happens, anyone trying to bully it receives a painful lesson.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.flavorText: As it digs through the sand, its giant jaws crush any rocks that obstruct its path. It builds a funnel-shaped nest.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.flavorText: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: From time immemorial, it has been venerated by agricultural peoples as an entity able to control the weather.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.flavorText: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts indiscriminately. This is because of the stress it feels at being unable to fly.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.flavorText: They lurk deep within caves—motionless, neither eating nor drinking. Why they don't die is not known.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.flavorText: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance and can be put to various uses.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: They live in mountains where no trace of humans can be detected. Jangmo-o grow little by little as they battle one another.

cards.name: Hakamo-o
cards.flavorText: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder and sharper each time they're regrown.

cards.name: Kommo-o
cards.flavorText: Its rigid scales function as offense and defense. In the past, its scales were processed and used to make weapons and other commodities.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: The child in its pouch leaves home after roughly three years. That is the only time the mother is heard to cry wildly.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.flavorText: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.flavorText: Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.flavorText: It spins thread from both its rear and its mouth. Then it wraps its prey up in thread and sips their bodily fluids at its leisure.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.flavorText: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

cards.name: Celebi ◇
cards.flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.flavorText: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.flavorText: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.flavorText: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.flavorText: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.flavorText: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

cards.name: Nincada
cards.flavorText: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

cards.name: Ninjask
cards.flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

cards.name: Combee
cards.flavorText: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.flavorText: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.flavorText: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.flavorText: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

cards.name: Tapu Bulu
cards.flavorText: The guardian deity of Ula'ula is a lazy Pokémon. It commands plants to immobilize its foes and then deals them a savage blow with its horns.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Quilava
cards.flavorText: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.flavorText: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.flavorText: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is so famed for its intellect that a proverb still persists in some regions: "When in doubt, ask Slowking."

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.flavorText: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.flavorText: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.flavorText: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.flavorText: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

cards.name: White Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can control water bubbles. It practice diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

cards.name: Brionne
