cards.flavorText: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try and help.

cards.name: Primarina
cards.flavorText: Its singing voice is its chief weapon in battle. This Pokémon's Trainer must prioritize the daily maintenance of its throat at all costs.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.flavorText: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.flavorText: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.flavorText: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Electricity leaks from it in amounts far greater than the amount of electricity it eats.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.flavorText: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.flavorText: It unleashes psychic power from the orb on its forehead. When its power is exhausted, the orb grows dull and dark.

cards.name: Unown
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Unown
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Unown
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it live quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

cards.name: Shedinja
cards.flavorText: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.flavorText: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.flavorText: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feels of those who hear it.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

cards.name: Nihilego
cards.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts, it's unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

cards.name: Poipole
cards.flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

cards.name: Naganadel
cards.flavorText: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: Apparently, the larger the green parts of this Pokémon, the more collectors value it. It's a particular favorite among elderly people.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.flavorText: If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like kicks, you may get a closer experience with one than you'd like.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Carbink
cards.flavorText: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.flavorText: When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

cards.name: Alolan Persian
cards.flavorText: It looks down on everyone other than itself. Its preferred tactics are sucker punches and blindside attacks.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavorText: With its black fur, it blends into the darkness. It bides its time, and when prey appears, this Pokémon goes for its threat, and then eats it.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett
cards.flavorText: Its golden hairs function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.flavorText: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters piece of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.flavorText: Once it has identified an enemy, this Pokémon smashes it mercilessly with pincers hard as steel.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Durant
cards.flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

cards.name: Magearna
cards.flavorText: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: Jigglypuff posses a vocal range that exceeds 12 octaves, but each individual's singing skill depends on its own effort.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: As it inhales, it expands…and expands…and expands. Wigglytuff compete to see which one can inflate itself the most.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.flavorText: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.flavorText: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enabled it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

cards.name: Carbink
cards.flavorText: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

cards.name: Xerneas ◇
cards.flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.flavorText: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.

cards.name: Ribombee
cards.flavorText: Some of Ribombee's pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.flavorText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

cards.name: Shiinotic
cards.flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

cards.name: Tapu Lele
cards.flavorText: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

cards.name: Tapu Fini
cards.flavorText: The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: Not only are these Pokémon fast runners, they're also few in number, so anyone who finds one must be lucky indeed.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy fur coat acts as a sensor, enabling it to read the feelings of people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Ditto ◇
cards.flavorText: With its astonishing capacity for metamorphosis, it can get along with anything. It does not get along well with its fellow Ditto.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.flavorText: The curved antlers change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: It draws symbols all over the place to mark its territory. In towns with many Smeargle, the walls are covered in graffiti.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.flavorText: Most people raise it for its milk, but it's quite tough and strong, so it's also well suited for battle.

cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.flavorText: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

cards.name: Pikipek
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for attacks it fires off from its mouth.

cards.name: Pikipek
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for attacks it fires off from its mouth.

cards.name: Trumbeak
cards.flavorText: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

cards.name: Toucannon
cards.flavorText: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavorText: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: It gets into territorial disputes with Vikavolt. For some reason, it apparently gets along well with Heracross in Alola.

cards.name: Shaymin ◇
cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, if it's not brushed diligently, it will be a mass of tangles before you know it.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: It is vindictive and relentless by nature. Those who cross it even once will be cursed for a thousand years, along with their descendants.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: It doesn't allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.flavorText: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it's called "the deity of destruction."

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude
cards.flavorText: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude
cards.flavorText: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

cards.name: Alolan Graveler
cards.flavorText: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the "fireworks of the earth."

cards.name: Alolan Golem
cards.flavorText: It's grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks and makes a meal of them. It usually nests in the holes gouged in trees by Pikipek.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

cards.name: Tapu Koko ◇
cards.flavorText: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.flavorText: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.flavorText: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.flavorText: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.flavorText: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn, as it contains venom.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: It was born from sludge on the ocean floor. In a sterile environment, the germs within its body can't multiply, and it dies.

cards.name: Muk
cards.flavorText: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak
cards.flavorText: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: Its sparkling core is called "the gem of the sea." This core can be made into high-priced accessories that are traded in secret.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.flavorText: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: The smallest of things could cause it to lose its temper. Because it doesn't hold in its stress, this Pokémon can live a long time.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: It will never forgive opponents who have angered it. Even after it has beaten them down until they can't move, it never ever forgives.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.flavorText: Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.flavorText: Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It's apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It's said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.flavorText: Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn't adapt in time and went extinct.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.flavorText: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

cards.name: Alolan Muk
cards.flavorText: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.flavorText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: Although it's said to bring disaster, in actuality, this Pokémon possesses a calm disposition and warns people of any crises that loom.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.flavorText: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. Since it's still at a playful age, it hops around friskily.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.flavorText: It circles in the sky, keeping a keen eye out for Pokémon in a weakened state. Its choicest food is Cubone.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.flavorText: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: Its metal body is sturdy, but it does rust rather easily. So on rainy days, this Pokémon prefers to stay put in its nest.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.flavorText: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.flavorText: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.flavorText: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales
cards.flavorText: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: Exeggutor is the pride of the Alolan people. Its image is carved into historical buildings and murals.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.flavorText: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.flavorText: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.flavorText: Restored from DNA found in amber, this Pokémon exhibited ferocity that was greater than expected. Some casualties resulted.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.flavorText: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.flavorText: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

cards.name: Pheromosa
cards.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavorText: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavorText: This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Xurkitree
cards.flavorText: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

cards.name: Poipole
cards.flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It's tough enough to run right through the night, and it's also a hard worker, but it's still just a youngster.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

cards.name: Buzzwole
cards.flavorText: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

cards.name: Guzzlord
cards.flavorText: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

cards.name: Celesteela
cards.flavorText: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

cards.name: Kartana
cards.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.flavorText: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

cards.name: Type: Null
cards.flavorText: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

cards.name: Pikipek
cards.flavorText: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses holes for food storage and for nesting.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

cards.name: Shiinotic
cards.flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.flavorText: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.flavorText: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash
cards.flavorText: Fleeing a volcanic eruption, it settled on a snowy mountain. As it races through the snowfields, it sends up a spray of snow.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Its elegant, attractive dance will send the minds and hearts of its enemies to another world.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.flavorText: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Lurantis
cards.flavorText: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.flavorText: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

cards.name: Komala
cards.flavorText: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

cards.name: Tapu Lele
cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.flavorText: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.flavorText: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.flavorText: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.

cards.name: Decidueye
cards.flavorText: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

cards.name: Tapu Bulu
cards.flavorText: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

cards.name: Silvally
cards.flavorText: Although its name was Type: Null at first, the boy who evolved it into this form gave it the name by which it is now known.

cards.name: Alolan Raichu
cards.flavorText: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

cards.name: Shining Ho-Oh
cards.flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

cards.name: Alolan Raichu
cards.flavorText: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

cards.name: Registeel
cards.flavorText: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Shining Celebi
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Shining Lugia
cards.flavorText: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.flavorText: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

cards.name: Tapu Fini
cards.flavorText: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.flavorText: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

cards.name: Wash Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.flavorText: Boiling blood, like plasma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Gumshoos
cards.flavorText: It adores having Rattata and Raticate for dinner, but as it's diurnal, it never encounters them. This Pokémon boasts incredible patience.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by horror and died of the shock.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

cards.name: Dawn Wings Necrozma
cards.flavorText: Lunala no longer has a will of its own. Now under the control of Necrozma, it continuously expels all of its energy.

cards.name: Dusk Mane Necrozma
cards.flavorText: This is its form with it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on its foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.

cards.name: Ash's Pikachu
cards.flavorText: This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer's cap. Since the cap's not the right size, the fit is a bit loose.

cards.name: Ash's Pikachu
cards.flavorText: This form of Pikachu is somewhat rare. It wears the hat of its Trainer, who is also its partner.

cards.name: Pheromosa
cards.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

cards.name: Xurkitree
cards.flavorText: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.

cards.name: Dawn Wings Necrozma
cards.flavorText: Lunala no longer has a will of its own. Now under the control of Necrozma, it continuously expels all of its energy.

cards.name: Dusk Mane Necrozma
