cards.name: Alolan Sandslash
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's steel spikes are sheathed in ice. Stabs from these spikes cause deep wounds and severe frostbite as well.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Possessing a calm demeanor, this Pokémon was revered as a deity incarnate before it was identified as a regional variant of Ninetales.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Celesteela
cards.flavorText: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.flavorText: It flies around on its wings, which have grown in at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames, burning up the fields it passes over.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Tapu Lele
cards.flavorText: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feel stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: A lonely Pokémon, it conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Ultra Necrozma
cards.flavorText: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

cards.name: Detective Pikachu
cards.flavorText: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

cards.name: Meltan
cards.flavorText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

cards.name: Stakataka
cards.flavorText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

cards.name: Melmetal
cards.flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: If it inhales deeply, that's a sign it's about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!

cards.name: Detective Pikachu
cards.flavorText: He was the partner of Tim's father, Harry, who has gone missing. This Pikachu loves the dark coffee at the Hi-Hat Cafe.

cards.name: Detective Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Skilled in deduction, he's a self-proclaimed "great detective." His detective hat is his trademark.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.flavorText: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

cards.name: Tapu Fini
cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

cards.name: Necrozma
cards.flavorText: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: It's so popular with the elderly that there's a magazine devoted to this Pokémon. Fans obsess over the particular length and angle of its arms.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

cards.name: Stakataka
cards.flavorText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Buzzwole
cards.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

cards.name: Phione
cards.flavorText: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

cards.name: Blacephalon
cards.flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created by Mewtwo to prove that copies can be even more powerful than their originals.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Armored Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: Mewtwo was on a rampage searching for meaning to its existence in this world when Giovanni suppressed and controlled its power.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.flavorText: Although it doesn't like disputes, it will sharpen the leaf on its tail into a blade and fight if it has to protect its friends.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.flavorText: It protects itself by freezing its fur into sharp needles. It can drop its body temperature below –75 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.flavorText: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.flavorText: It prefers harsh environments, such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.flavorText: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder to repel enemies. It will eat different plants depending on where it lives.

cards.name: Spewpa
cards.flavorText: Spewpa doesn't live in a fixed location. It roams where it pleases across the fields and mountains, building up the energy it needs to evolve.

cards.name: Vivillon
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.flavorText: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the back of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.flavorText: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Floragato
cards.flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

cards.name: Meowscarada
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

cards.name: Spidops ex
cards.flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

cards.name: Smoliv
cards.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Smoliv
cards.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Dolliv
cards.flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

cards.name: Arboliva
cards.flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Toedscruel
cards.flavorText: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

cards.name: Scovillain
cards.flavorText: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

cards.name: Arcanine ex
cards.flavorText: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.flavorText: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

cards.name: Crocalor
cards.flavorText: The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

cards.name: Skeledirge
cards.flavorText: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Armarouge
cards.flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Gyarados ex
cards.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.flavorText: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.flavorText: Clauncher's claws will regrow if they fall off. The meat inside the claws is edible, but it has a distinct flavor that doesn't appeal to all tastes.

cards.name: Clawitzer
cards.flavorText: The cannonballs of seawater that Clawitzer launches from its claw are powerful enough to punch through tanker hulls.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.flavorText: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

cards.name: Quaxly
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

cards.name: Quaxwell
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

cards.name: Quaquaval
cards.flavorText: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

cards.name: Wugtrio
cards.flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

cards.name: Cetoddle
cards.flavorText: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

cards.name: Cetoddle
cards.flavorText: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

cards.name: Cetitan
cards.flavorText: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

cards.name: Dondozo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

cards.name: Tatsugiri
cards.flavorText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges electromagnetic waves and so on from the units at its sides.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: They're formed by several Magnemite linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

cards.name: Magnezone ex
cards.flavorText: They're formed by several Magnemite linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electricity in its fur.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.flavorText: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.flavorText: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.flavorText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.flavorText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

cards.name: Pawmo
cards.flavorText: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

cards.name: Pawmot
cards.flavorText: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

cards.name: Kilowattrel
cards.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

cards.name: Miraidon
cards.flavorText: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

cards.name: Miraidon ex
cards.flavorText: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Gardevoir ex
cards.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.flavorText: It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.

cards.name: Banette ex
cards.flavorText: It feeds on the dark emotions of sadness and hatred, which make it grow steadily stronger.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.flavorText: This Flabébé rides a red flower. Immediately after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in search of a flower it likes.

cards.name: Floette
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.

cards.name: Florges
cards.flavorText: They say that flower gardens created by Florges are constantly showered with a power that can heal both body and spirit.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.flavorText: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

cards.name: Fidough
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

cards.name: Fidough
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

cards.name: Dachsbun
cards.flavorText: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

cards.name: Espathra
cards.flavorText: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

cards.name: Greavard
cards.flavorText: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

cards.name: Greavard
cards.flavorText: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

cards.name: Houndstone
cards.flavorText: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

cards.name: Annihilape
cards.flavorText: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.flavorText: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.flavorText: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.flavorText: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.flavorText: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

cards.name: Silicobra
cards.flavorText: Silicobra's neck pouch, which can inflate and deflate like a balloon, gets more elastic each time Silicobra sheds its skin.

cards.name: Sandaconda
cards.flavorText: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

cards.name: Stonjourner
cards.flavorText: The elemental composition of the rocks that form its body were found to match the bedrock of a land far away from this Pokémon's habitat.

cards.name: Klawf
cards.flavorText: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

cards.name: Great Tusk ex
cards.flavorText: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

cards.name: Koraidon
cards.flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

cards.name: Koraidon ex
cards.flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

cards.name: Muk
cards.flavorText: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak ex
cards.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

cards.name: Kingambit
cards.flavorText: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

cards.name: Maschiff
cards.flavorText: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

cards.name: Maschiff
cards.flavorText: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

cards.name: Mabosstiff
cards.flavorText: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

cards.name: Bombirdier
cards.flavorText: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.flavorText: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.flavorText: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

cards.name: Revavroom
cards.flavorText: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

cards.name: Iron Treads ex
cards.flavorText: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.flavorText: It's Seviper's archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.

cards.name: Starly
cards.flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.flavorText: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.flavorText: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

cards.name: Skwovet
cards.flavorText: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

cards.name: Greedent
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

cards.name: Indeedee
cards.flavorText: In search of happy feelings—such as joy and gratitude—Indeedee bustles around, taking diligent care of people and other Pokémon.

cards.name: Lechonk
cards.flavorText: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

cards.name: Oinkologne
cards.flavorText: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Oinkologne ex
cards.flavorText: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.flavorText: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.flavorText: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

cards.name: Maushold
cards.flavorText: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

cards.name: Squawkabilly
cards.flavorText: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

cards.name: Cyclizar
cards.flavorText: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

cards.name: Cyclizar
cards.flavorText: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

cards.name: Flamigo
cards.flavorText: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as "synchronizing," an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

cards.name: Dolliv
cards.flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Scovillain
cards.flavorText: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

cards.name: Armarouge
cards.flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.flavorText: Clauncher's claws will regrow if they fall off. The meat inside the claws is edible, but it has a distinct flavor that doesn't appeal to all tastes.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is blown across vast distances by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of Paldea originally came from.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.flavorText: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon's head.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.flavorText: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

cards.name: Combee
cards.flavorText: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.flavorText: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

cards.name: Snover
cards.flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.flavorText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Floragato
cards.flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

cards.name: Spidops
cards.flavorText: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

cards.name: Nymble
cards.flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

cards.name: Nymble
cards.flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

cards.name: Lokix
cards.flavorText: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

cards.name: Bramblin
cards.flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Bramblin
cards.flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Brambleghast
cards.flavorText: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

cards.name: Rellor
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

cards.name: Rellor
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.flavorText: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.flavorText: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.flavorText: It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies around easily, even while carrying prey that weighs more than 220 lbs.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.flavorText: When Litleo are young, female Pyroar will teach them how to hunt. Once the Litleo mature, they will leave the pride and set out on their own.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.flavorText: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It's thanks to them that their pride doesn't starve.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.flavorText: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.flavorText: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

cards.name: Crocalor
cards.flavorText: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.flavorText: It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.flavorText: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.flavorText: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

cards.name: Eiscue
cards.flavorText: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.

cards.name: Quaxly
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

cards.name: Quaxly
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

cards.name: Quaxwell
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

cards.name: Cetoddle
cards.flavorText: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

cards.name: Cetoddle
cards.flavorText: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

cards.name: Cetitan
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

cards.name: Veluza
cards.flavorText: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

cards.name: Frigibax
cards.flavorText: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

cards.name: Frigibax
cards.flavorText: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

cards.name: Arctibax
cards.flavorText: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

cards.name: Baxcalibur
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

cards.name: Pincurchin
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

cards.name: Pincurchin
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.flavorText: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

cards.name: Pawmo
cards.flavorText: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

cards.name: Pawmot
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

cards.name: Tadbulb
cards.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

cards.name: Tadbulb
cards.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

cards.name: Kilowattrel
cards.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is normally very innocent. When it is staring at something invisible, it is unblinking and utterly silent.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of nights when the starlight is bright.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.flavorText: Gothitelle unleashes psychic energy and shows opponents dreams of the universe's end. These dreams are apparently ethereal and beautiful.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.flavorText: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else— like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.flavorText: The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

cards.name: Ceruledge
cards.flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

cards.name: Rabsca
cards.flavorText: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

cards.name: Tinkatuff
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

cards.name: Tinkatuff
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

cards.name: Tinkaton
cards.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.flavorText: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.flavorText: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.flavorText: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries. It won't obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls without skill.

cards.name: Falinks
cards.flavorText: The brass, which is the one that stands at the front and issues orders, is the strongest and smartest of the six.

cards.name: Nacli
cards.flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

cards.name: Nacli
cards.flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

cards.name: Naclstack
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

cards.name: Garganacl
cards.flavorText: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

cards.name: Glimmet
cards.flavorText: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

cards.name: Glimmet
cards.flavorText: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

cards.name: Glimmora
cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

cards.name: Deino
cards.flavorText: It can't see, so its first approach to examining things is to bite them. You will be covered in wounds until a Deino warms up to you.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.flavorText: The two heads do not get along at all. If you don't give each head the same amount of attention, they'll begin fighting out of jealousy.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.flavorText: Only the central head has a brain. It is very intelligent, but it thinks only of destruction.

cards.name: Maschiff
cards.flavorText: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

cards.name: Maschiff
cards.flavorText: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

cards.name: Mabosstiff
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

cards.name: Shroodle
cards.flavorText: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

cards.name: Shroodle
cards.flavorText: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

cards.name: Grafaiai
cards.flavorText: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

cards.name: Bombirdier
cards.flavorText: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon's chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

cards.name: Corviknight
cards.flavorText: Corviknight can't serve as a taxi service in Paldea because the Pokémon's natural predators will attack it while it flies, endangering the customer.

cards.name: Cufant
cards.flavorText: Using the pointy tip of its trunk, it carves off chunks of hard rocks to eat. It is very docile and helps people with physical labor.

cards.name: Orthworm
cards.flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.flavorText: Though very small, the brain in its tail is still considered an important organ because it emits powerful psychic energy.

cards.name: Farigiraf
cards.flavorText: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

cards.name: Dudunsparce
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.flavorText: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.flavorText: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.flavorText: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.flavorText: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.flavorText: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

cards.name: Rookidee
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

cards.name: Corvisquire
cards.flavorText: It's said that the reason behind Corvisquire's high level of intelligence is the large size of its brain relative to those of other bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.flavorText: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.flavorText: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

cards.name: Maushold
cards.flavorText: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

cards.name: Flamigo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Floragato
cards.flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

cards.name: Bramblin
cards.flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.flavorText: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.flavorText: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It's thanks to them that their pride doesn't starve.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.flavorText: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

cards.name: Crocalor
cards.flavorText: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

cards.name: Eiscue
cards.flavorText: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.

cards.name: Quaxly
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

cards.name: Quaxwell
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

cards.name: Frigibax
cards.flavorText: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

cards.name: Arctibax
cards.flavorText: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

cards.name: Baxcalibur
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of nights when the starlight is bright.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.flavorText: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else— like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

cards.name: Rabsca
cards.flavorText: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

cards.name: Tinkatuff
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.flavorText: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

cards.name: Nacli
cards.flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.flavorText: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

cards.name: Grafaiai
cards.flavorText: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

cards.name: Orthworm
cards.flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

cards.name: Rookidee
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

cards.name: Maushold
cards.flavorText: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

cards.name: Flamigo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

cards.name: Farigiraf
cards.flavorText: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

cards.name: Dudunsparce
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.flavorText: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.flavorText: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.flavorText: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.flavorText: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

cards.name: Combee
cards.flavorText: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.flavorText: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.flavorText: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss's caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.flavorText: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.flavorText: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.flavorText: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.flavorText: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

cards.name: Steenee
cards.flavorText: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

cards.name: Smoliv
cards.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Dolliv
cards.flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

cards.name: Arboliva
cards.flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.flavorText: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.flavorText: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

cards.name: Scovillain
cards.flavorText: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.flavorText: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.flavorText: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence—or so it's said.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.flavorText: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Armarouge
cards.flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.flavorText: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.flavorText: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.flavorText: Many of this species can be found along the shorelines of cold regions. If a Cubchoo lacks dangling snot, there's a chance it is sick.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.flavorText: It is a ferocious, carnivorous Pokémon. Once it captures its prey, it will breathe cold air onto the prey to freeze and preserve it.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.flavorText: Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said that people and Pokémon who die on snowy mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 600 metres in a minute's time.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

cards.name: Wugtrio
cards.flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

cards.name: Finizen
cards.flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

cards.name: Finizen
cards.flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

cards.name: Palafin
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.flavorText: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.flavorText: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

cards.name: Tadbulb
cards.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

cards.name: Tadbulb
cards.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

cards.name: Tadbulb
cards.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

cards.name: Bellibolt
cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

cards.name: Bellibolt
cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

cards.name: Togepi
