cards.flavorText: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

cards.name: Nickit
cards.flavorText: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

cards.name: Thievul
cards.flavorText: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: Some theories suggest that its behavior of forcefully bashing its head into things stimulates cells that affect its evolution.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.flavorText: Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will be able to fly.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart's desire—wings.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Deino
cards.flavorText: Because it can't see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.flavorText: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.flavorText: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won't slow until their target goes down.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

cards.name: Flapple
cards.flavorText: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

cards.name: Appletun
cards.flavorText: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

cards.name: Regidrago
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavorText: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.flavorText: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.flavorText: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.flavorText: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it's intelligent, obedient to its Trainer's commands, and easy to raise.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.flavorText: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.flavorText: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.flavorText: A combative Pokémon, it's ready to pick a fight with anyone. It has talons that can crush hard berries.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.flavorText: Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and belligerent, it's Corviknight that's taken the role of transportation in Galar.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.flavorText: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.flavorText: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.flavorText: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

cards.name: Rapid Strike Scroll of the Flying Dragon
Single Strike Scroll of the Fanged Dragon
Froslass
cards.flavorText: It spits out cold air of nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozen prey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.

cards.name: Inteleon
cards.flavorText: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.flavorText: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.flavorText: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.flavorText: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.flavorText: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.flavorText: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.flavorText: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

cards.name: Accelgor
cards.flavorText: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.flavorText: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.flavorText: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.flavorText: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.flavorText: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

cards.name: Gossifleur
cards.flavorText: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

cards.name: Eldegoss
cards.flavorText: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

cards.name: Zarude
cards.flavorText: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.flavorText: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.flavorText: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

cards.name: Sizzlipede
cards.flavorText: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

cards.name: Sizzlipede
cards.flavorText: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

cards.name: Centiskorch
cards.flavorText: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

cards.name: Centiskorch
cards.flavorText: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.flavorText: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: No number of injuries can bother Staryu. Its amazing regenerative powers return it to its previous state in half a day!

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: It rotates its geometrically shaped body to swim through the water. It always seems to be sending out mysterious radio waves.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.flavorText: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That's why this Pokémon is never cold.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.flavorText: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.flavorText: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.flavorText: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Marshtomp
cards.flavorText: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

cards.name: Swampert
cards.flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

cards.name: Clamperl
cards.flavorText: Clamperl's pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder's pearls.

cards.name: Huntail
cards.flavorText: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

cards.name: Gorebyss
cards.flavorText: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.flavorText: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

cards.name: Basculin
cards.flavorText: Known for their violence, these Pokémon have the most fights with schools of red-striped Basculin.

cards.name: Galarian Darumaka
cards.flavorText: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

cards.name: Galarian Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: Though it has a gentle disposition, it's also very strong. It will quickly freeze the snowball on its head before going for a headbutt.

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.flavorText: It moves around by jetting water from its right pincer. It has a poor sense of balance, so it's terrible at swimming straight.

cards.name: Clawitzer
cards.flavorText: Its right arm is packed with meat. When its pincer falls off, it's exported to be used as a cooking ingredient.

cards.name: Pyukumuku
cards.flavorText: It's covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

cards.name: Chewtle
cards.flavorText: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

cards.name: Drednaw
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

cards.name: Arrokuda
cards.flavorText: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.

cards.name: Barraskewda
cards.flavorText: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

cards.name: Snom
cards.flavorText: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

cards.name: Frosmoth
cards.flavorText: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Minun
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: With a body made of plasma, it can inhabit all sorts of machines. It loves to surprise others.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: The sun powers this Pokémon's electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.flavorText: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.flavorText: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.flavorText: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.flavorText: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.flavorText: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.flavorText: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.flavorText: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.flavorText: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

cards.name: Galarian Corsola
cards.flavorText: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others' life-force through its branches.

cards.name: Galarian Cursola
cards.flavorText: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Munna
cards.flavorText: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.flavorText: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.flavorText: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.flavorText: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.flavorText: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

cards.name: Indeedee
cards.flavorText: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

cards.name: Dreepy
cards.flavorText: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

cards.name: Drakloak
cards.flavorText: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it'll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

cards.name: Dragapult
cards.flavorText: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: When its skin gets wrinkled from moisture, it heads for a volcano. It lies flat on a spot with a lot of geothermal heat and dries itself out.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its thick claws, it's good at climbing trees. There are plenty of Sandslash that park themselves in trees and go right to sleep.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavorText: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

cards.name: Golem
cards.flavorText: It detonates its own body. The power from that explosion can propel it up steep mountain paths with amazing speed.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.flavorText: There's a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.flavorText: Hariyama that are big and fat aren't necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.flavorText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.flavorText: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.flavorText: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

cards.name: Clobbopus
cards.flavorText: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

cards.name: Grapploct
cards.flavorText: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

cards.name: Falinks
cards.flavorText: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

cards.name: Falinks
cards.flavorText: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

cards.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
cards.flavorText: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

cards.name: Galarian Linoone
cards.flavorText: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon
cards.flavorText: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: It booms out a victory croak when its prey goes down in defeat. This Pokémon and Seismitoad are related species.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.flavorText: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.flavorText: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.flavorText: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Impidimp
cards.flavorText: It sneaks into people's homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

cards.name: Morgrem
cards.flavorText: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

cards.name: Grimmsnarl
cards.flavorText: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.flavorText: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

cards.name: Galarian Meowth
cards.flavorText: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker
cards.flavorText: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

cards.name: Durant
cards.flavorText: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.flavorText: Long ago it lived in mines, but once the minerals that make up its diet became scarcer, Klefki began appearing in human settlements.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

cards.name: Meltan
cards.flavorText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

cards.name: Melmetal
cards.flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

cards.name: Corviknight
cards.flavorText: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.

cards.name: Cufant
cards.flavorText: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

cards.name: Copperajah
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.flavorText: Their horns are powerful sensors. As soon as Goomy pick up any sign of enemies, they go into hiding. This is how they've survived.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.flavorText: The lump on its back contains its tiny brain. It thinks only of food and escaping its enemies.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.flavorText: Its form of offense is forcefully stretching out its horns. The strikes land 100 times harder than any blow from a heavyweight boxer.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.flavorText: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn't get along with Galarian Meowth.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: Because the eggs on their bellies have been overharvested by people in the past, the Chansey population remains very small.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is overflowing with love. Only Chansey that share a strong bond with their Trainer can evolve, so people say.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.flavorText: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it can launch a swift counterattack if it's attacked by an enemy.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.flavorText: It's notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.flavorText: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.flavorText: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.flavorText: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

cards.name: Rookidee
cards.flavorText: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

cards.name: Corvisquire
cards.flavorText: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.flavorText: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.flavorText: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

cards.name: Dubwool
cards.flavorText: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.flavorText: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.flavorText: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

cards.name: Burmy
cards.flavorText: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

cards.name: Wormadam
cards.flavorText: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Mothim
cards.flavorText: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.flavorText: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.flavorText: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.flavorText: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.flavorText: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

cards.name: Crawdaunt
cards.flavorText: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.flavorText: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.flavorText: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.flavorText: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.flavorText: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

cards.name: Eiscue
cards.flavorText: The hair on its head connects to the surface of its brain. When this Pokémon has something on its mind, its hair chills the air around it.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.flavorText: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.flavorText: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.flavorText: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.flavorText: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: Since Dedenne can't generate as much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

cards.name: Milcery
cards.flavorText: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

cards.name: Alcremie
cards.flavorText: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.flavorText: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.flavorText: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

cards.name: Wormadam
cards.flavorText: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

cards.name: Throh
cards.flavorText: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh's belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer's sweat.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.flavorText: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it's best to quietly pass by.

cards.name: Golett
cards.flavorText: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.flavorText: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

cards.name: Muk
cards.flavorText: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

cards.name: Impidimp
cards.flavorText: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

cards.name: Morgrem
cards.flavorText: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

cards.name: Grimmsnarl
cards.flavorText: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

cards.name: Wormadam
cards.flavorText: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.flavorText: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.flavorText: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

cards.name: Klink
cards.flavorText: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

cards.name: Klang
cards.flavorText: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.flavorText: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sides of caves heated by geothermal energy. This way, Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other's strength.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.flavorText: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.flavorText: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

cards.name: Castform
cards.flavorText: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

cards.name: Starly
cards.flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.flavorText: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.flavorText: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.flavorText: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.flavorText: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.flavorText: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.flavorText: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: Since Dedenne can't generate as much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

cards.name: Alcremie
cards.flavorText: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.flavorText: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

cards.name: Grookey
cards.flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

cards.name: Sobble
cards.flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

cards.name: Rillaboom
cards.flavorText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

cards.name: Frosmoth
cards.flavorText: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker
cards.flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.flavorText: Its body secrets oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

cards.name: Gossifleur
cards.flavorText: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.flavorText: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Galarian Ponyta
cards.flavorText: Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few rubs from this Pokémon's horn, any slight wound you have will be healed.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Flapple
cards.flavorText: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Coalossal
cards.flavorText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.flavorText: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

cards.name: Duraludon
cards.flavorText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Zacian
cards.flavorText: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

cards.name: Zamazenta
cards.flavorText: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

cards.name: Decidueye
cards.flavorText: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

cards.name: Arctozolt
cards.flavorText: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.flavorText: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Hatenna
cards.flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Eldegoss
cards.flavorText: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

cards.name: Drednaw
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

cards.name: Centiskorch
cards.flavorText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

cards.name: Coalossal
cards.flavorText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Alcremie
cards.flavorText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon
cards.flavorText: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

cards.name: Duraludon
cards.flavorText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Grookey
cards.flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

cards.name: Sobble
cards.flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attacks won't be able to resist weeping.

cards.name: Special Delivery Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Special Delivery Charizard
cards.flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Rime
cards.flavorText: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

cards.name: Polteageist
cards.flavorText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.flavorText: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.flavorText: The faint scent that emanates from its full blossom entices bug Pokémon to it.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Arrokuda
cards.flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Cinderace
cards.flavorText: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

cards.name: Inteleon
cards.flavorText: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.flavorText: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.flavorText: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

cards.name: Galarian Articuno
cards.flavorText: Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires beams that can immobilize opponents as if they had been frozen solid.

cards.name: Galarian Zapdos
cards.flavorText: One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.

cards.name: Galarian Moltres
cards.flavorText: The sinister aura that blazes like molten fire around this Pokémon is what inspired the name Moltres.

cards.name: Galarian Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Eiscue
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavorText: On the night of a full moon, or when it gets excited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.

cards.name: Light Toxtricity
cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

cards.name: Pyukumuku
cards.flavorText: It's covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.flavorText: It unleashes psychic power from the orb on its forehead. When its power is exhausted, the orb grows dull and dark.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Special Delivery Bidoof
cards.flavorText: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Flapple
cards.flavorText: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's tail is blade sharp, with a fantastic cutting edge that can slice right though large trees.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.flavorText: The coldness emanating from Glaceon causes powdery snow to form, making it quite a popular Pokémon at ski resorts.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon
cards.flavorText: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

cards.name: Hisuian Basculegion
cards.flavorText: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

cards.name: Wyrdeer
cards.flavorText: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

cards.name: Hisuian Samurott
cards.flavorText: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.flavorText: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Some dancers use its graceful, elegant dancing as inspiration.

cards.name: Sylveon
cards.flavorText: There's a Galarian fairy tale that describes a beautiful Sylveon vanquishing a dreadful dragon Pokémon.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name "scalchop."

cards.name: Radiant Eevee
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy

cards.name: Finneon
cards.flavorText: It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

cards.name: Comfey
cards.flavorText: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.flavorText: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.flavorText: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.flavorText: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

cards.name: Hisuian Basculin
cards.flavorText: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor - this one is gentle - I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

cards.name: Cranidos
cards.flavorText: Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It snapped trees by headbutting them, and then it fed on their ripe berries.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: It starts life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

cards.name: Rillaboom
cards.flavorText: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

cards.name: Cinderace
cards.flavorText: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

cards.name: Inteleon
cards.flavorText: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

cards.name: Galarian Articuno
cards.flavorText: Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires beams that can immobilize opponents as if they had been frozen solid.

cards.name: Galarian Zapdos
cards.flavorText: One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.

cards.name: Galarian Moltres
cards.flavorText: The sinister aura that blazes like molten fire around this Pokémon is what inspired the name Moltres.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

cards.name: Quilladin
cards.flavorText: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

cards.name: Chesnaught
cards.flavorText: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.flavorText: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

cards.name: Delphox
cards.flavorText: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.flavorText: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.flavorText: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.flavorText: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.flavorText: If it is around babies, it milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

cards.name: Skitty
