cards.flavorText: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.flavorText: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

cards.name: Furfrou
cards.flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

cards.name: Head Ringer Team Flare Hyper Gear
Jamming Net Team Flare Hyper Gear
Weedle
cards.flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

cards.name: Grovyle
cards.flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Sceptile
cards.flavorText: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

cards.name: Sceptile
cards.flavorText: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.flavorText: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.flavorText: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.flavorText: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.flavorText: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction–to and fro and sideways.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.flavorText: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

cards.name: Volbeat
cards.flavorText: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

cards.name: Illumise
cards.flavorText: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.flavorText: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.flavorText: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.flavorText: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Blaziken
cards.flavorText: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Marshtomp
cards.flavorText: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

cards.name: Swampert
cards.flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

cards.name: Swampert
cards.flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.flavorText: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.flavorText: Its whiskers make a superb radar. They are used to locate prey, even in the murkiest of water.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.flavorText: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.flavorText: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms in schools and lives at the bottom of rivers.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.flavorText: It is the world's most beautiful Pokémon. There are many works of art featuring Milotic.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.flavorText: Be it Spheal or a Poké Ball, it will spin any round object on its nose with the greatest of ease.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.flavorText: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.

cards.name: Clamperl
cards.flavorText: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

cards.name: Huntail
cards.flavorText: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

cards.name: Gorebyss
cards.flavorText: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

cards.name: Gorebyss
cards.flavorText: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.flavorText: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light. With the prey incapacitated, the Pokémon swallows it in a single gulp.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.flavorText: Small and very docile, it protects itself with its small, poisonous horn when attacked.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.flavorText: When feeding its young, it first chews the food into a paste, then spits it out for the offspring.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.flavorText: The body is covered by stiff, needle-like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.flavorText: The body is covered by stiff, needle-like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.flavorText: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.flavorText: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.flavorText: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.flavorText: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.flavorText: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.flavorText: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.flavorText: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.flavorText: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.

cards.name: Crawdaunt
cards.flavorText: Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all Pokémon that enter its territory with its pincers and throws them out.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.flavorText: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.flavorText: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.flavorText: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.flavorText: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.flavorText: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavorText: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavorText: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life-forms can survive.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.flavorText: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Desert Spirit," this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

cards.name: Zigzagoon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

cards.name: Linoone
cards.flavorText: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.flavorText: The chances of two Spinda having identical spot patterns is less than one in four billion.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.flavorText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.flavorText: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.flavorText: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life-form more like plant seeds.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.flavorText: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.flavorText: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.flavorText: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.flavorText: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.flavorText: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

cards.name: Nincada
cards.flavorText: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

cards.name: Ninjask
cards.flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

cards.name: Shedinja
cards.flavorText: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.flavorText: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.flavorText: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.flavorText: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.name: Banette
cards.flavorText: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

cards.name: Banette
cards.flavorText: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Binacle
cards.flavorText: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.flavorText: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom bringer.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.flavorText: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another's rights and avoid needless strife.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.flavorText: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another's rights and avoid needless strife.

cards.name: Carbink
cards.flavorText: Born from temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.flavorText: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. It is said to have the ability to change the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.flavorText: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.flavorText: It's uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speed of over 180 mph.

cards.name: Taillow
cards.flavorText: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

cards.name: Swellow
cards.flavorText: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

cards.name: Swellow
cards.flavorText: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.flavorText: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.flavorText: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves fell close to anyone other than their Trainers.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.flavorText: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.flavorText: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: Its scientific name is "Oddium Wanderus." At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.flavorText: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.flavorText: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.flavorText: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

cards.name: Combee
cards.flavorText: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.flavorText: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.flavorText: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.flavorText: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: It has evolved to be suitable for an aquatic life. It can invisibly melt away into water.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

cards.name: Regice
cards.flavorText: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Unown
cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.flavorText: It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.

cards.name: Golett
cards.flavorText: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It's been active for thousands of years.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.flavorText: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavorText: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavorText: This carefree Pokémon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.flavorText: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.flavorText: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: It converses with others by magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.flavorText: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.flavorText: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

cards.name: Registeel
cards.flavorText: Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal. A study has revealed that its body is hollow.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.flavorText: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.flavorText: It's covered in a slimy membrane that makes any punches or kicks slide off it harmlessly.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.flavorText: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells, rather than using ears or a nose.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.flavorText: It attacks with retractable horns. It throws a punch that's the equivalent of the force of a hundred pro boxers.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. It is capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error…

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error…

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: It swings its long antlers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.flavorText: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.flavorText: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn't faze it.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.flavorText: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn't faze it.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

cards.name: Quilladin
cards.flavorText: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.

cards.name: Chesnaught
cards.flavorText: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

cards.name: Spewpa
cards.flavorText: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

cards.name: Vivillon
cards.flavorText: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.flavorText: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.flavorText: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Quilava
cards.flavorText: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.flavorText: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.flavorText: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.flavorText: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.flavorText: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Snover
cards.flavorText: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.flavorText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.flavorText: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.flavorText: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.flavorText: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity instantly downing foes several times its size.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within 3,300 feet.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal the victim's life force. It lurks in darkness for prey.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: It likes playing mischievous tricks, such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.flavorText: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.flavorText: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.flavorText: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.flavorText: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.flavorText: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.flavorText: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: It always wears the skull of its dead mother, so no one has any idea what its hidden face looks like.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.flavorText: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavorText: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.flavorText: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.flavorText: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.flavorText: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.flavorText: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.flavorText: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.flavorText: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.flavorText: It can make most any Pokémon run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.flavorText: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

cards.name: Floette
cards.flavorText: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

cards.name: Florges
cards.flavorText: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

cards.name: Spritzee
cards.flavorText: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

cards.name: Aromatisse
cards.flavorText: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.flavorText: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.flavorText: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

cards.name: Noivern
cards.flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It emerges out of the dark to attack.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.flavorText: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.flavorText: It always stand on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavorText: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Starly
cards.flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.flavorText: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.flavorText: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.flavorText: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.flavorText: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.flavorText: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.flavorText: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.flavorText: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

cards.name: Durant
cards.flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.flavorText: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.flavorText: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.flavorText: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.flavorText: They prefer unpolluted southern seas. Their coral branches lose their color and deteriorate in dirty water.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.flavorText: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.flavorText: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: If you think that you had a good dream but you can't remember it, a Drowzee has probably eaten it.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.flavorText: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.flavorText: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.flavorText: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.flavorText: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.flavorText: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.flavorText: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.flavorText: Apparently, it can detect innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

cards.name: Skrelp
cards.flavorText: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.flavorText: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: It flies at speeds equals to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.flavorText: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 feet per second that can level houses.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.flavorText: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Spritzee
cards.flavorText: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

cards.name: Aromatisse
cards.flavorText: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

cards.name: Dragalge
cards.flavorText: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It searches wide areas for food.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.flavorText: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.flavorText: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.flavorText: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

cards.name: Furfrou
cards.flavorText: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Sylveon
cards.flavorText: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.flavorText: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of all living creatures.

cards.name: Dragalge
cards.flavorText: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.flavorText: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.flavorText: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.flavorText: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.flavorText: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.flavorText: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

cards.name: Treecko
cards.flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.flavorText: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavorText: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life-forms can survive.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.flavorText: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.flavorText: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: It lures its prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.flavorText: It's uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Chesnaught
cards.flavorText: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

cards.name: Black Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: White Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.flavorText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

cards.name: Arceus
cards.flavorText: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.flavorText: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn't faze it.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.flavorText: It gathers things it likes and pushes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavorText: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it's filled with a mysterious power.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude and the message it delivers.

cards.name: Arceus
cards.flavorText: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.flavorText: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are too fast to follow.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: White Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body becomes frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves with volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

cards.name: Vivillon
cards.flavorText: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Floette
cards.flavorText: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.flavorText: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

cards.name: Clawitzer
cards.flavorText: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.flavorText: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.

cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.flavorText: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Black Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.flavorText: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.flavorText: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

cards.name: Magearna
cards.flavorText: Magearna, with its metallic body, is an artificial Pokémon created 500 years ago by humans.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom bringer.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

cards.name: Magearna
cards.flavorText: Magearna, with its metallic body, is an artificial Pokémon created 500 years ago by humans.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.flavorText: When it is resolute, it body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during the nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Arceus
cards.flavorText: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

cards.name: Servine
cards.flavorText: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
